title: Mid-Market Outcomes Architect, Japan
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 5+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working - Native level Japanese, business level English NICE TO HAVES - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy. https://dev.notion.so/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: People Operations Specialist
description: At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. We're looking for someone who loves building automations, agents and workflows, and wants to point that instinct at People Ops. You'll own the data and systems behind our People Ops stack (HiBob, Ashby, Remote), and use that ownership as the foundation for turning slow, manual, multi-tool processes into things that mostly run themselves. This is a role for someone who'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month planning the perfect system - someone who gets a genuine kick out of making the unglamorous stuff disappear. You’ll bring expertise, energy, and commercial thinking to help us elevate our People processes. Key responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain automations, workflows, and AI agents across our People Ops tooling (HiBob, Ashby, Remote) - from a simple triggered workflow to a more sophisticated internal agent - turning multi-step manual processes into things that run themselves. Own the data layer everything else depends on: keep HiBob/Ashby/Remote data clean, resolve integration and schema issues between systems, and treat data integrity as the foundation of what you build, not an afterthought. Run new joiner onboarding end to end, but treat every manual step you touch twice as a candidate for automation, with the goal is to keep making the process faster and lighter-touch, not just execute it reliably. Administer employee lifecycle changes (promotions, transfers, terminations) across systems, and build the guardrails - validation rules, alerts, review steps etc, that catch data errors before they become a downstream mess in payroll or compliance. Process documentation: create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and playbooks for onboarding, offboarding, and systems admin current as processes evolve, so nothing lives only in your head. Partner with relevant stakeholders on anything touching UK employment or compliance judgement calls while you build fluency here. You own the system and the escalation path, and that ownership shifts to you over time. Your background: You can genuinely build: hands-on with automation/workflow tools (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n, Retool or similar), and you've actually built or configured AI agents. You've worked with structured data and APIs enough to reason about schemas, integrations, and what breaks when two systems disagree with each other. You're comfortable being the systems administrator of SaaS platforms: owning permissions, workflows, and integrations, ideally across an HRIS/ATS/EOR stack (HiBob, Ashby, Remote) or a comparable set of business systems. You've worked in a high-growth environment, ideally remote and across multiple geographies, and you're comfortable working async across EMEA time zones. Any exposure to People Ops, HR systems, or UK employment practices is a genuine bonus, not a requirement - we're hiring for the builder instinct first, and will coach the domain knowledge. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You're an Owner. You don't wait to be told the onboarding flow needs fixing, you notice the friction and you just fix it. You're Fast. You'd rather ship a working automation this week and improve it next week than spend a month designing the perfect one. You like Simple. Your default build is the one with the fewest moving parts, not the most impressive one. You find Surprising in the unglamorous stuff. You get a kick out of turning "someone does this by hand every month" into something nobody thinks about again. You're Human, even with agents. You know the systems you're building sit behind someone's first week at a new job, or a colleague's benefits question — you design for that person, not just for the workflow diagram. KPIs & Success Measures Number and scope of manual People Ops processes automated, and time saved per cycle HiBob / Ashby / Remote data accuracy rate Time to resolve employee systems requests Reduction in error rate flowing into compliance-relevant fields Benefits: 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development Remote - work from anywhere in your home country Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees Flexible working hours Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Account Management (TAM) Leader
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE The Technical Account Manager (TAM) Leader owns the health, direction, and performance of the Technical Account Management function. Where an individual TAM is the primary technical partner for their own portfolio of accounts, the TAM Leader is accountable for the entire TAM book — every account covered by the team, every partner relationship with a technical dimension, and the people who deliver against them. The TAM Leader is both a player and a coach: they carry direct accountability for coverage decisions, escalation outcomes, and cross-functional alignment, while spending the majority of their time developing the individual TAMs so the team's proactive, relationship-first approach scales without becoming a response channel. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES PEOPLE LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT The TAM Leader hires, coaches, and grows the TAM team so each member operates as a credible, proactive technical partner to their accounts. This includes: - Hiring and onboarding new TAMs, including running them through the TAM Path ramp - Running regular 1:1s, setting individual development plans, and giving direct feedback on account plans, QBRs, and escalation handling - Building and maintaining repeatable playbooks (upgrade runbooks, optimization playbooks, escalation patterns) so quality doesn't depend on tenure - Setting and holding the team to a consistent bar for technical depth, proactivity, and communication PORTFOLIO & COVERAGE OWNERSHIP The TAM Leader owns the coverage model for the entire function — deciding, tracking, and refreshing who is assigned where, and closing gaps as they surface. This includes the two account universes the role is accountable for: - Named accounts — the full book maintained in the Draft TAM Accounts doc https://app.notion.com/p/3b35004b775f805ab27ed2cfede681c1?pvs=21, currently ~$33.1M ARR across 120 accounts split across the team, capped at 20 accounts per TAM - Partner-mapped accounts — every partner with a named Technical Account Manager in the Partner Mappings https://app.notion.com/p/9715782ec0d645368d2bea677ae90759?pvs=21, spanning Strategic AI, Growth, and Other tiers - Running the quarterly review/refresh of assigned accounts, rebalancing books as ARR and strategic relationships shift - Resolving open coverage gaps (e.g. regions or account types with no TAM alignment) and deciding when a controlled exception, a new hire, or a change in tier definition is the right fix - Approving leadership-discretion assignments and cap exceptions, and making the trim/reassign calls when an account is dropped for capacity CUSTOMER TECHNICAL OWNERSHIP (OVERSIGHT) The TAM Leader ensures every assigned account — named or partner-mapped — has a clear, accountable technical owner. They spot-check account documentation, architecture understanding, and risk tracking across the book, and step in directly on the most strategic or highest-risk accounts. ONBOARDING AND ADOPTION (OVERSIGHT) The TAM Leader ensures the team consistently shortens time to value for new accounts by: - Auditing that architecture and deployment validation is happening post-sale, not skipped - Coaching TAMs on configuration guidance and best-practice delivery - Tracking early success milestones across the portfolio, not just account by account PROACTIVE TECHNICAL GUIDANCE (OVERSIGHT) The TAM Leader ensures environment reviews and risk/optimization surfacing happen on a regular cadence across the whole book, covering scalability, reliability, security, and lifecycle planning — and holds the team accountable when reviews lapse. ISSUE MANAGEMENT AND ESCALATION The TAM Leader is the escalation layer above the individual TAM — brought in on complex, high-impact, or multi-stakeholder issues rather than replacing the TAM as primary contact. This includes: - Coordinating across support, engineering, and success during major incidents - Owning execution of the Named Account Escalation SLA sequence when it's triggered - Ensuring root cause analysis and preventative action actually close out, not just the immediate fire - Isolating TAMs from technical repair work so they can stay focused on the relationship while the right team handles the fix STRATEGIC TECHNICAL PLANNING (OVERSIGHT) The TAM Leader ensures account plans across the book stay aligned to customer roadmaps, and personally engages on capacity, architecture, or growth planning for the largest or most strategic accounts and partners. INTERNAL COLLABORATION ENGINEERING AND PRODUCT The TAM Leader represents the aggregated voice of the customer — patterns across accounts, not just one-off feedback — to engineering and product, and prioritizes which recurring pain points or gaps get pushed for a fix versus handled as one-offs. SUPPORT The TAM Leader maintains the operating agreement between TAM and Support (TAMs are not frontline support) and is the point of escalation when that boundary needs adjudicating on a specific account. SALES AND CUSTOMER SUCCESS The TAM Leader partners with Sales and Success leadership on account health and retention at the portfolio level — surfacing which accounts or partners are trending at risk, and where TAM coverage itself needs to change to protect NRR. PARTNERSHIPS Because the TAM Leader owns the Technical Account Manager assignments inside the Partner Mappings, they work directly with each partner's Account Quarterback, Partner Manager, and Solutions Architect to make sure the technical relationship keeps pace with partner stage (Prospecting through Scaling) and tier (Strategic AI, Growth, Other) — while staying out of commercial terms, which live with the Partner Manager. SUCCESS METRICS Common indicators of TAM Leader effectiveness include: - Coverage: % of the $33.1M+ named-account book and partner-mapped accounts with an assigned, active TAM - Team health: ramp time to productivity for new TAMs, retention of the TAM team itself - Customer adoption and usage depth across the book - Reduction in critical incidents and time to resolution for escalated issues, portfolio-wide - Customer satisfaction and retention (NRR) across named and partner-mapped accounts - Consistency: QBR completion rate and account plan quality across the team, not just top performers TOOLS USED BY THE TAM TEAM This section documents the tools and systems used by the Technical Account Management team. It is intended to be kept up to date as tooling evolves. - Admin Studio - Grafana - Hex - pgAdmin - HubSpot (account ARR, tier, and health data) - Notion — Draft TAM Accounts doc and Partner Mappings database SCOPE OF COVERAGE The TAM Leader is accountable for the full combined book the function covers, not a single portfolio: 1. Named accounts in the Draft TAM Accounts doc https://app.notion.com/p/3b35004b775f805ab27ed2cfede681c1?pvs=21 — every account already assigned to one of the individual TAMs, plus resolution of open decisions such as the current APAC coverage gap 2. Partner-mapped accounts in the Partner Mappings https://app.notion.com/p/9715782ec0d645368d2bea677ae90759?pvs=21 — ensuring every partner that warrants a technical relationship has a named TAM against it, and that the mapping stays current as partners move through Stage and Tier ACCOUNT MAPPING TAM Standard (Pooled) 1. Spend — For customers at $100K ARR, access to pooled TAM resources for a set (time TBD) hours per month 2. Pooled TAM SKU — Customers of any scale can purchase pooled access to the TAM team (requires Enterprise Support SKU) 3. Leadership Discretion for Customer Needs TAM Premium (Dedicated) 1. Spend — For customers at $250K ARR, access to a dedicated TAM resource for a set (time TBD) hours per month 2. Dedicated TAM SKU — Customers of any scale can purchase an assigned TAM (requires Enterprise Support SKU) 3. Leadership Discretion for Customer Needs The TAM Leader owns tier decisions, the quarterly refresh of this mapping, and any leadership-discretion exceptions. WHAT TAM LEADERS DO NOT DO To keep the function focused and scaling, the TAM Leader does not: - Replace the individual TAM as an account's day-to-day technical relationship owner — accounts scale by layering support on, not by handing off - Perform day-to-day operational work for customers - Own or negotiate commercial terms for either named accounts or partner deals — that stays with the AE or Partner Manager - Act as professional services for custom implementations - Manage frontline support case queues IDEAL INDIVIDUAL A world-class Technical Account Manager Leader at Supabase has done the individual TAM job well and now wants to multiply it across a team. - Technical depth — Same bar as an individual TAM: can go deep on database internals, scalability, security posture, and infrastructure tradeoffs, and can still credibly work a strategic account directly when needed - People leadership — Has hired, coached, and grown a technical team before; gives direct, specific feedback and knows how to develop someone from good to great - Portfolio-level judgment — Can look across 100+ accounts and a partner book and tell where coverage is thin, where an account should move tiers, and where to spend leadership discretion - Escalation command — Comfortable being the senior voice in a high-severity, multi-stakeholder incident, coordinating support, engineering, and success without adding noise - Cross-functional influence at altitude — Represents patterns across the whole book to engineering, product, sales, and partnerships leadership — not just one account's feedback - Communication clarity — Can brief an executive on portfolio health and coach a TAM through a root cause analysis in the same day - Retention and expansion awareness — Understands that TAM Leader performance shows up in aggregate NRR across the book; proactively rebalances coverage toward the accounts and partners most at risk - Experience — Background in engineering, SRE, or technical consulting, plus a track record of leading a technical customer-facing team SUMMARY The Technical Account Manager Leader exists to make sure every account and partner relationship the TAM function is accountable for — the full Draft TAM Accounts book and the entire Partner Mappings coverage — has a technical owner, and that the team delivering against it keeps getting better. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. title: Pre-Sales Solutions Architect (SA) Leader
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE The Pre-Sales Solutions Architect (SA) Leader owns the health, direction, and performance of the Solutions Architecture function. Where an individual SA is the technical owner within the sales cycle for their assigned opportunities, the SA Leader is accountable for technical win rate and deal velocity across the entire pre-sales motion — every channel the team supports, and the people who deliver against it. The SA Leader is a player-coach: they carry direct accountability for channel coverage, the most strategic or highest-stakes evaluations, and cross-functional GTM alignment, while spending the majority of their time developing individual SAs so the team's proactive, commercially-sharp approach scales without becoming order-taking. Compensation Note: SA Leader compensation is tied to team-wide ARR bookings — new logo, expansion, and multi-year commitments across every SA's pipeline, not just deals the Leader personally works. The Leader is expected to operate with the same commercial mindset as the team, at portfolio scale. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES PEOPLE LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT The SA Leader hires, coaches, and grows the SA team so each member operates as a credible, commercially sharp technical partner in the sales cycle. This includes: - Hiring and onboarding new SAs, including calibrating them against the channel-specific technical evaluation prompts - Running regular 1:1s, reviewing deal strategy, PoC scoping, and objection handling, and giving direct feedback - Building and maintaining repeatable playbooks (discovery frameworks, PoC templates, objection/RFP responses, competitive positioning) so quality doesn't depend on tenure - Setting and holding the team to a consistent bar for technical depth, commercial instinct, and quota attainment CHANNEL & COVERAGE OWNERSHIP The SA Leader owns the coverage model for the entire function — deciding, tracking, and rebalancing which SAs support which channels, and closing gaps as pipeline shifts. This includes accountability across all five channels in the SA Channel Mapping https://app.notion.com/p/Solutions-Architect-SA-Overview-3835004b775f81789255e36a2fb4b799?pvs=21: - Direct Sales (AMER, EMEA, APJ) - Hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) - Accelerators, Incubators, VCs (YCombinator, TechStars, 500 Startups) - SfP + OAuth Partners (Lovable, Bolt, Anthropic) - Solution Providers (Postgres.ai http://Postgres.ai, Stormatics) - Rebalancing SA assignment across channels as pipeline volume, deal complexity, or new partner motions shift - Resolving coverage gaps (a channel with no dedicated SA depth, or a region outgrowing its current allocation) and deciding when a hire, a cross-channel reassignment, or a controlled exception is the right fix - Approving which opportunities warrant Leader-level involvement directly, versus staying with the assigned SA TECHNICAL SALES OWNERSHIP (OVERSIGHT) The SA Leader ensures every significant opportunity has a clear, accountable technical owner across architecture fit, use cases, evaluation criteria, and competitive positioning — spot-checking deal documentation and risk tracking across the pipeline, and stepping in directly on the largest or most strategic evaluations. DISCOVERY AND TECHNICAL QUALIFICATION (OVERSIGHT) The SA Leader ensures the team consistently qualifies opportunities as technically winnable early, coaching SAs on discovery quality and holding the team accountable for surfacing deal-level risk to AEs and sales leadership before it costs a deal. PROOF OF CONCEPT AND EVALUATION SUPPORT (OVERSIGHT) The SA Leader ensures PoCs across the team are scoped to demonstrate differentiated value, not just technical box-checking — auditing success criteria, evaluation structure, and win-rate patterns across the whole book of active evaluations. TECHNICAL OBJECTION HANDLING (OVERSIGHT) The SA Leader is the escalation layer above the individual SA for the hardest architecture, security, or compliance objections — brought in on RFPs, security questionnaires, and competitive deals that could stall without senior technical input, without replacing the SA as the deal's primary technical contact. COMMERCIAL TECHNICAL ALIGNMENT (OVERSIGHT) The SA Leader ensures the team consistently connects technical requirements to commercial outcomes across the pipeline, and personally engages on pricing/packaging justification and expansion-signal strategy for the largest deals. INTERNAL COLLABORATION SALES (ACCOUNT EXECUTIVES) The SA Leader partners with Sales leadership to make sure SA/AE pairing is working at the portfolio level — owning the technical narrative in aggregate while sales leadership owns the commercial motion — and personally steps in when a specific SA/AE partnership needs adjudicating. PARTNERSHIPS The SA Leader works with Partner Leads across every channel (Hyperscalers, Accelerators, SfP+OAuth, Solution Providers) to make sure SA support scales with each channel's motion, while commercial terms and channel strategy stay owned by the Partner Lead. ENGINEERING AND PRODUCT The SA Leader represents the aggregated market signal — patterns across deals, not just one opportunity — to engineering and product, and prioritizes which recurring technical blockers or roadmap gaps are costing the team deals versus which are one-offs. TECHNICAL ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT (TAM) AND CUSTOMER ENGINEERING The SA Leader ensures handoff quality from pre-sale to post-sale is consistent across the team — auditing that architecture decisions, commitments, and open items are documented well enough that TAMs and CEs can drive early adoption without re-discovering the deal. SUCCESS METRICS SA Leader effectiveness is measured by commercial and technical outcomes across the whole team, not just their own deals: - Team ARR Bookings — new logo and expansion ARR across every SA's pipeline, relative to team quota - Deal Velocity — time from technical qualification to technical win, tracked across channels - PoC Win Rate — percentage of structured evaluations that convert to closed-won, team-wide - Pipeline Coverage — volume and quality of SA-engaged opportunities relative to quota, per channel - Handoff Quality — post-sale team satisfaction with documentation and deal context, across the team - Team health — ramp time to productivity for new SAs, retention of the SA team itself TOOLS USED BY THE SA TEAM This section documents the tools and systems used by the Solutions Architecture team. It is intended to be kept up to date as tooling evolves. - HubSpot - Hex - AdminConsole - Grafana SCOPE OF COVERAGE The SA Leader is accountable for technical pre-sales coverage across every channel the function supports, not a single book of deals: 1. Direct Sales (AMER, EMEA, APJ) 2. Hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI) 3. Accelerators, Incubators, VCs (YCombinator, TechStars, 500 Startups) 4. SfP + OAuth Partners (Lovable, Bolt, Anthropic) 5. Solution Providers (Postgres.ai http://Postgres.ai, Stormatics) Each channel requires a different selling motion and technical path to win; the SA Leader ensures the team's channel assignment and playbooks keep pace with where pipeline is actually moving. WHAT SA LEADERS DO NOT DO To keep the function focused and scaling, the SA Leader does not: - Own post-sale technical delivery or ongoing account management — that stays with TAM/CE - Perform implementation or professional services work outside of a formal PoC - Take over account health monitoring - Set or negotiate commercial terms independently of the AE or Partner Lead - Replace the individual SA as a deal's primary technical contact — the Leader escalates in, they don't take over IDEAL INDIVIDUAL A world-class SA Leader at Supabase has done the individual SA job well — deeply technical, commercially sharp, genuinely curious about how customers build — and now wants to multiply that across a team. - Technical depth — Can still design a production-grade architecture in a discovery call, debug a PoC, and earn credibility with a CTO on the spot - People leadership — Has hired, coached, and grown a technical sales team before; gives direct, specific feedback and knows how to develop an SA into a future lead - Channel-level judgment — Can look across all five channels and tell where coverage is thin, where a channel's motion is shifting, and where to reallocate SA attention - Commercial instinct at scale — Thinks in team-wide ARR bookings, not just their own quota; knows which deals warrant Leader-level involvement - Expansion mindset — Coaches SAs to proactively surface new teams, workloads, and use cases that grow account footprint, and does the same personally on the largest deals - Communication range — Equally credible whiteboarding with a senior engineer, coaching an SA through a hard escalation, and briefing sales leadership on pipeline health - Internal leverage — Turns competitive patterns, objection responses, and architecture templates from individual deals into playbooks that scale across the team - Quota attainment (team) — Track record of carrying and closing a pre-sales quota personally, plus experience being accountable for a team's aggregate number - Experience — Has built something in production, comes from an engineering, founding, or hands-on technical background, and has led a technical, customer-facing team SUMMARY The Pre-Sales Solutions Architect Leader exists to make sure every channel the SA function is accountable for — Direct Sales, Hyperscalers, Accelerators, SfP+OAuth Partners, and Solution Providers — has the right technical coverage to win deals, and that the team delivering against it keeps getting better. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Chief of Staff, CRO
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h3> <p>Join us at a pivotal moment as we scale our revenue operations globally. As Chief of Staff to the CRO, you'll serve as a strategic partner and force multiplier to our revenue leadership team, driving operational excellence and orchestrating  high-impact initiatives. As part of the Office of the CRO, you'll also manage our Communications lead and CRO Initiatives Program Manager, giving you direct ownership over how the CRO's key initiatives get built and run. This highly visible role offers a unique opportunity to shape strategy at the executive level while developing your path to senior leadership.</p> <p>You'll work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution translating vision into action while maintaining the organizational agility needed in a high-growth environment.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>The responsibilities encompass direct assignments driven by the CRO as well as autonomous  leadership efforts informed by the feedback and key priorities of the CRO leadership team. This role will help enable communication, collaboration, strategy execution, and special projects across the CRO organization. </p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CRO and revenue leadership on strategy, initiatives, and organizational priorities</li> <li>Drive leadership operations , including weekly executive staff meetings, QBRs, and strategic planning cycles with insights that inform decision-making</li> <li>Lead the CRO team's goal-setting and tracking across the global revenue organization</li> <li>Effectively triage escalations and drive cross-functional resolution of complex business blockers and time-sensitive customer issues</li> <li>Serve as CRO proxy in reviewing account plans, preparing briefing materials, and managing key customer and partner meetings with clear agendas and follow-ups</li> <li>Ensure timely follow-up on critical customer and partner interactions to drive business outcomes</li> <li>Serve as CRO Board Liaison, prepare board materials, investor updates, and collaborate on executive presentations and organizational announcements</li> <li>Maintain strategic partnerships with CEO's Chief of Staff, Sales Strategy & Analytics, Field Operations, Finance, and People teams to drive cross-functional alignment</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with executives and senior leaders to achieve project objectives and deliverables</li> <li>Identify delegation opportunities and optimize the CRO's time allocation to ensure focus on the highest-value strategic activities</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8-12 years of progressive experience in strategic roles such as chief of staff, top-tier management consulting, corporate strategy, or revenue operations leadership at high-growth technology companies. You combine strategic thinking with exceptional execution skills and thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.</li> <li>Proven track record leading cross-functional projects, influencing senior stakeholders, and delivering results in matrixed organizations</li> <li>Executive presence and confidence in managing conversations with Board members, C-Suite, and senior leaders across the organization</li> <li>Strong analytics and reporting capabilities with experience translating data into actionable insights that drive business decisions</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce), business intelligence tools, and presentation software</li> <li>Demonstrated success in building scalable processes and operating systems that improve organizational efficiency</li> <li>Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to shift priorities quickly while maintaining control across multiple projects</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with strong emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively across all organizational levels and functions</li> <li>Detail-oriented and results-driven with strong initiative, self-motivation, and a bias toward action</li> <li>Exceptional written communication, comfort documenting in public, and experience operating in an async environment</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or related field (or equivalent work experience)</li> <li>Ability to travel as needed to support the CRO</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The GitLab Revenue Team builds and scales the go-to-market capabilities that power our global growth and customer success. Acting as strategic partners to customers and internal stakeholders, the team aligns revenue solutions with company objectives to acquire, expand, and retain world-class customers.<br><br></p> <p>The Revenue Team spans multiple functions working in coordination: Sales teams drive new business and expansion across territories and segments; Customer Success ensures adoption and value realization; Sales Strategy & Analytics provides insights and enablement; Field Operations optimizes processes and systems; and Partner teams extend our market reach through channel and alliance relationships. As a fully distributed, async-first team, the Revenue Team serves as the growth engine of the company, provides data-driven insights on pipeline and forecast, and champions initiatives that strengthen market execution while modeling the collaboration practices that enable GitLab's remote culture to thrive at scale.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

an internal capability that uses AI to accelerate plan modeling, scenario simulation, payout forecasting, and what-if analysis across thousands of sellers and territories.</li> <li>Leverage AI to design high-quality SPIFFs and incentive structures, including generating candidate designs, simulating seller behavior, and stress-testing against historical data before launch.</li> <li>Track ROI of comp plans, SPIFFs, and incentive programs using AI-driven analytics - Comfort building or directing the build of AI-powered internal applications is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including the ability to architect new metrics for emerging business models (consumption, AI monetization).</li> <li>Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with proven experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives.</li> <li>Proven experience driving Executive Steering Committee meetings and owning the decision narrative end-to-end.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional initiatives to completion across Finance, HR, IT, Product, and GTM.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with a strategic mindset.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate combines a strong background in sales strategy and compensation design with genuine curiosity about applying AI to transform the function. title: Staff Corporate Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer, you'll help secure the systems GitLab team members rely on every day across a fully remote environment. This role sits within Corporate Security Engineering and focuses on building secure-by-default controls for endpoints and the SaaS platforms that support them, with a strong emphasis on macOS. You'll own meaningful technical decisions around endpoint hardening, automation, and detection, and you'll help turn security requirements into scalable engineering systems that are measurable, auditable, and designed to reduce friction for end users.</p> <p>This is a strong fit if you're motivated by solving security problems with code. You will work across endpoint management, identity, and security operations to improve how GitLab manages macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux devices through Infrastructure-as-Code, Terraform, and GitOps workflows. In your first year, you'll be expected to strengthen endpoint security architecture, expand automation, and improve the reliability and auditability of how controls are deployed and maintained.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead the security architecture of GitLab's endpoint fleet and related infrastructure, with a primary focus on macOS.</li> <li>Design and support automation for secure endpoint deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management using code-based workflows.</li> <li>Manage endpoint and SaaS security configuration through Terraform, version control, merge requests, continuous integration pipelines, and automated rollouts.</li> <li>Define and enforce security baselines across macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.</li> <li>Develop patching and software distribution approaches that align with security, compliance, and operational requirements.</li> <li>Partner with Information Technology, Security Operations, and Detection and Response teams to improve endpoint telemetry, detections, and response models.</li> <li>Drive process improvements that reduce manual work and lower risk by favoring automation, policy-driven controls, and auditable change management.</li> <li>Mentor engineers across Corporate Security and Information Technology, and serve as a senior escalation point for complex endpoint security issues.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience designing and delivering endpoint, systems, or corporate security solutions in environments that require scalable, durable controls.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of endpoint management platforms such as Jamf Pro or FleetDM, especially for architecting and securing macOS environments.</li> <li>Strong hands-on ability with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices, including module design, state management, and pipeline-based deployment.</li> <li>Experience working with GitOps workflows where changes are managed through Git repositories, merge requests, code review, and automated pipelines.</li> <li> Strong proficiency in scripting or programming for automation and security tooling, such as bash, Python, PowerShell, or Go.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud identity providers and directories, including platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, LDAP.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate across distributed teams, and work independently in an all-remote environment.</li> <li>Openness to bringing transferable experience from adjacent security, systems, or platform engineering backgrounds, along with a practical and security-focused approach to problem solving.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The Corporate Security Engineering team secures the internal environment GitLab team members use every day, including endpoints, identity systems, SaaS applications, and platforms that store sensitive internal data. It's a small, high-leverage team that treats security work as engineering work: building with code, operating through Git, and using reviewable, testable, and auditable workflows by default. You’ll provide practical, business-focused guidance that helps GitLab manage legal risk and meet business needs across a globally distributed, all-remote organization.</p> <p>You’ll independently lead complex employment-law matters, serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, and help strengthen how GitLab manages employment risk across jurisdictions. You’ll also contribute to scalable legal processes, share subject-matter expertise, and mentor legal colleagues and cross-functional partners.</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li>Provide senior, practical employment-law advice to team members and stakeholders across GitLab, balancing legal risk, business objectives, and GitLab’s values.</li> <li>Advise on matters across the employment lifecycle, including recruiting and onboarding, compensation, performance management, leave management, employee relations, works council processes, organizational changes, separation, and post-employment issues.</li> <li>Counsel People Business Partners, Team Member Relations partners, and business leaders on complex and sensitive team-member relations concerns.</li> <li>Advise on, draft, maintain, and review employment agreements, separation agreements, policies, templates, and related documentation across multiple jurisdictions.</li> <li>Review, draft, and negotiate employment-related agreements, including separation agreements and other documents supporting employee lifecycle decisions.</li> <li>Advise on employment compliance requirements across EMEA, identify when advice from local counsel is needed, and incorporate that advice into strategies that match the business.</li> <li>Monitor and analyze changes in employment, privacy, and related laws; identify legal risks; and translate developments into practical recommendations and implementable guidance.</li> <li>Advise on the employment-law and privacy implications of team-member data, including familiarity with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other local privacy requirements.</li> <li>Support employment litigation, appeals tribunals, agency investigations, employment coordinating local counsel, defining scope, and maintaining effective relationships and advice across jurisdictions.</li> <li>Provide employment advice in regions outside EMEA as needed.</li> <li>Lead the development and continuous improvement of scalable employment-law processes, systems, playbooks, templates, and supporting documentation for the Legal and People teams.</li> <li>Build clear, consistent approaches that enable stakeholders to handle recurring employment matters efficiently while escalating complex or high-risk issues appropriately.</li> <li>Serve as a subject-matter resource for legal colleagues and cross-functional partners, sharing expertise and helping improve team-wide employment-law practices.</li> <li>Mentor and support junior legal colleagues and other partners by contributing to training, practical guidance, and knowledge-sharing programs.</li> <li>Use GitLab to collaborate transparently and work effectively in an asynchronous, globally distributed environment.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience advising a multinational company with works councils in various regions on employment matters across the employment relationship.</li> <li>A Juris Doctor (JD), Bachelor of Laws (LLB), or local equivalent, with admission to an applicable governing body in an EMEA jurisdiction.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of employment compliance requirements across EMEA, with the judgment to identify when advice from local counsel is needed.</li> <li>Experience counseling People Business Partners, Team Member Relations partners, and business leaders on sensitive and complex team-member relations matters, investigations, litigation, compensation, and works council strategy.</li> <li>Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating employment agreements, separation agreements, policies, templates, and related documentation across multiple jurisdictions.</li> <li>Experience drafting employment policies that apply across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.</li> <li>Familiarity with GDPR and other local privacy requirements related to team-member data.</li> <li>Experience managing employment disputes, litigation, appeals tribunals, agency investigations, works council relationships, and outside-counsel matters.</li> <li>Experience building or significantly improving legal processes, systems, playbooks, templates, and documentation that produce consistent outcomes at scale.</li> <li>Strong issue-spotting, risk-assessment, and judgment skills, with the ability to provide clear recommendations and practical solutions.</li> <li>The ability to manage a high volume of complex legal matters independently and bring them to resolution with limited supervision.</li> <li>Clear communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Legal, People, and the business.</li> <li>A practical and creative approach to problem-solving, sound business judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work across functions, time zones, and cultures.</li> <li>Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed, asynchronous environment; willingness to learn and use GitLab in your day-to-day work.</li> <li>We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable experience.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Employment Legal team supports GitLab throughout the employment relationship and works closely with People Business Partners, Team Member Relations, Legal colleagues, and other teams across the business.</p> <p>The team helps GitLab navigate employment requirements across multiple jurisdictions, manage disputes and investigations, build clear, scalable processes for an all-remote organization, and educate stakeholders regarding employment law requirements. In your first year, success looks like driving customer outcomes through technical workshops and architecture guidance, developing trusted relationships with key stakeholders, increasing adoption of follow-up actions, customer communications, and clear exit criteria.</li> <li>Analyze GitLab usage, adoption, and maturity signals to identify risks, prioritize interventions, and recommend next steps.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Practical understanding of Git, common branching strategies, and modern software development lifecycles.</li> <li>Working knowledge of continuous integration, continuous deployment, and DevSecOps practices.</li> <li>Experience guiding customers through technical or architectural decisions in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience facilitating technical workshops, enablement programs, and structured customer adoption initiatives.</li> <li>Experience partnering with customers to define business outcomes and translate them into actionable success plans, key goals, and measures.</li> <li>Background in customer success, post-sales, or professional services roles focused on adoption, retention, and satisfaction.</li> <li>Ability to manage a portfolio of customers, including handling escalations and coordinating across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services.</li> title: VP, Growth
description: About Nivoda Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology. We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point. Our Mission 🚀 Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know. The Marketing Team ⭐️ We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity. About the Role We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working. You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in. What would you be doing? Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it What do we need from you? Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team Nice to have Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup Our culture and what we offer 🌍 We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way. Our current benefits ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture 🏡 Remote work 🏥 Private health insurance 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare) 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location. Equal opportunity Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not. Join our Talent Pool Not quite the right role, or the timing isn't right? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we'll be in touch when something fits: https://nivoda.net/talent-pool Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.</p> <p>You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role exists</strong></h2> <p>Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Product contribution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.</li> <li>Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.</li> <li>Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Strategic technical stewardship</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.</li> <li>Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.</li> <li>Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.</li> <li>Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.</li> <li>Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.</li> <li>Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.</li> <li>Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Thought leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.</li> <li>Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.</li> <li>Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.</li> <li>Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.</li> <li>Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.</li> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.</li> <li>Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.</li> <li>The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal customization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strongly preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.</li> <li>A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Technologies and title: Account Manager, SMB

You'll be responsible for strategically expanding customer relationships, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, and proactively managing retention. To succeed in this role, you will need to be curious, asking insightful questions to understand customer needs and challenges, while being resilient in overcoming obstacles that may arise. You’ll need to be commercially minded, ensuring you’re delivering value to customers while identifying areas for growth. This role will require you to work seamlessly across teams, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and change will be key.
