title: Regulatory Reporting Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London / Cardiff / UK Remote | 💰£70,600 - £83,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Regulatory Reporting team⭐</strong></p> <p>We’re searching for an ambitious, innovative and caring professional to help inspire and develop our Regulatory Reporting team. </p> <p>Reporting into the Regulatory Reporting Policy Team Senior Manager, the role is primarily responsible for ensuring our horizon scanning and interpretation activities (e.g, PRA Rulebook, EU CRR) are correctly reflected in our capital, liquidity and financial returns, and monitoring our adherence to the applicable UK and European prudential rules on an ongoing basis. This includes identifying and defining any changes required to data and production quickly and safely.</p> <p>Combining the learnings of some of the fastest growing tech companies in the world with your own unique approach, you will manage a high-energy, dynamic workstream to foster open, collaborative, and inclusive working, embrace change, and inspire continuous learning. You will help enable Monzo to scale into a world-class, diverse and passionate group of people capable of effecting change across the globe.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proactively identifying and interpreting the rules, regulations and guidance applicable to the Regulatory Reporting team at Monzo, and ensuring ongoing compliance in the production of returns.  </li> <li>Developing, implementing, documenting  and maintaining the processes and controls required to maintain Monzo’s interpretations.</li> <li>Ensure that the processes and controls in place to produce returns are compliant with the applicable regulations in order to facilitate accurate, complete and timely reporting.   </li> <li>Working closely with our engineers and data scientists to ensure we source the correct data efficiency, accuracy and timelines consistently across the reporting suite. </li> <li>Working with a range of internal stakeholders, including Treasury, Risk, Data and project teams, to navigate and agree on what can be complex or ambiguous regulations in order to achieve the safest outcome for Monzo. </li> <li>Facilitate robust, appropriate governance over the identification and interpretation of the applicable regulations and the implementation of the rule in reporting outputs.</li> <li>Review all capital, liquidity and financial regulatory returns and any other returns the Regulatory Reporting team produces to ensure compliance with applicable regulations. </li> <li>Instilling a culture of continuous improvement throughout and engaging effectively with relevant stakeholders to implement changes that lead to improvement. </li> <li>Play a key role in the automation of Monzo’s regulatory reporting, specifically implementation, user acceptance testing and maintenance.   </li> <li>Ensuring that changes to processes that support regulatory reporting are implemented quickly and safely.  </li> <li>Developing, implementing and maintaining the governance and control framework required for regulatory reporting and expected by our Regulators. </li> <li>Contribute towards our ambitious expansion plans including supporting the rest of Monzo and ensuring that the Regulatory Reporting team is always an enabler.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have experience understanding and operationalising a wide range of regulatory requirements and the associated reporting.</li> <li>You have experience in the large-scale implementation and testing of automated reporting solutions.  </li> <li>You are able to identify areas for improvement, propose dynamic solutions and implement these changes quickly and safely.  </li> <li>You have excellent planning, organisation and time-management skills and are able to manage people on this basis. </li> <li>You can demonstrate a proven track record of excellent team leadership and coaching skills with the ability to provide empathy and guidance.</li> <li>You're excited to leverage technology to automate reporting and capital management with a track record of continuous process improvement.</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail and are numerically astute.</li> <li>You are self-motivated, ‘hands-on’ and take satisfaction in supporting colleagues, projects or tasks however big or small.</li> <li>Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>💰 £70,600 - 83,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Initial video call with hiring manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Role specific interview with Regulatory team (45 mins)</li> <li>Behavioural interview (45 mins)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here. </a></p> <p>#LI-NZ1 #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

Develop clear business cases and recommendations for significant technology investments. Ideal Experience & Qualifications 12+ years of progressive leadership experience spanning technology, digital operations, enterprise systems, product management, data, cybersecurity, or related disciplines. Strong experience with cybersecurity, technology governance, privacy-supporting controls, risk management, and organizational resilience. Experience leading CRM, data, analytics, digital platforms, enterprise applications, and major technology implementations. Experience overseeing technology budgets, contracts, licensing, vendor relationships, and implementation partners. Experience introducing and scaling AI-enabled solutions, governance, adoption, and training. Ability to translate organizational needs into practical technology priorities, investments, and execution plans. Executive presence and strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Ability to operate effectively in a mission-driven, distributed, and evolving environment. Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced degree or relevant certifications preferred. Deep alignment with Shatterproof's mission and values. title: Senior Program Manager, Enterprise Technology and AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div> <h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Senior Program Manager </strong>within GitLab's Enterprise Technology organization, you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technology programs that advance our enterprise IT strategy. You'll serve as a trusted advisor and program execution partner to IT leadership, translating strategic objectives into structured roadmaps and measurable outcomes. This is a highly visible role that requires both technical fluency and business acumen, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse stakeholders, and drive decisions across teams.</p> <p>You will operate at the intersection of IT, Finance, Legal, Product, and Business operations, bringing structure and clarity to programs that span multiple domains and functions. Whether standing up new capabilities, improving governance practices, or scaling operational processes, you will be the connective tissue that keeps programs moving, risks surfaced, and stakeholders informed.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end program management for large-scale or high-complexity Enterprise Technology & AI initiatives, including scope definition, roadmap development, resource planning, and delivery tracking</li> <li>Define and communicate clear success metrics for each program, reporting status and risk to Enterprise Technology & AI leadership on a regular cadence, and escalating issues with recommended paths forward</li> <li>Partner with business and technology stakeholders to develop a deep understanding of underlying problems, desired outcomes, and solution trade-offs</li> <li>Drive cross-functional alignment by facilitating decision-making, resolving dependencies, and maintaining momentum across distributed teams</li> <li>Recommend and implement improvements to program governance frameworks, intake processes, and ways of working across the CIO org</li> <li>Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable work plans accessible to both technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Anticipate risks and interdependencies across the portfolio, proactively mitigating blockers before they impact delivery</li> <li>Model GitLab values and remote work best practices, contributing to a high-trust, async-first team culture</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>6+ years of program management experience, with a strong track record delivering large, cross-functional Enterprise Technology & AI programs</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to simplify complex processes and build structured approaches to ambiguous problems</li> <li>Experience influencing without authority, earning trust with senior stakeholders, and driving alignment across functions, including Finance, Legal, Sales, and Product</li> <li>Comfortable operating at both a strategic level and in the details, switching between executive communication and hands-on program execution as needed</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting program status, risks, and recommendations to ETA leadership and Executive audiences</li> <li>Familiarity with Enterprise IT domains such as business systems, data, AI, security, infrastructure, or enterprise architecture (depth in one or more areas preferred)</li> <li>Proficiency with program and project management tools and methodologies (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or similar); PMP, CSM, or equivalent certification is a plus</li> <li>Experience working in a remote, globally distributed environment with a bias toward async collaboration and clear documentation</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The <strong>CIO Enterprise Technology & AI</strong> team is GitLab's central engine for improving the systems, data, and AI capabilities that support how we run the business. The team designs and operates enterprise applications, data platforms, corporate IT services, and AI-enabled workflows that help our globally distributed GitLab team members work effectively and securely.</p> <p>You'll join a team that partners closely with <strong>Finance, Sales, Marketing, People, Product, and Security</strong> to turn business strategy into scalable, reliable technology solutions. The work is broad, visible, and deeply cross-functional, which makes strong program leadership essential. In this role, you'll help teams stay aligned, make progress across complex initiatives, and bring transparency to how strategic work gets delivered across the organization.</p> </div> <div> </div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

description: Role Summary The Costing Engineer â Jigs & Fixtures is responsible for the end-to-end financial estimation of specialized tooling required for electronic assembly lines. This role involves analyzing technical drawings, calculating manufacturing costs for custom parts, and budgeting for complex automation components. The goal is to provide accurate "Should-Cost" models that ensure high-quality assembly solutions are delivered within budget. Cost Savings: Success in identifying 5-10 %$ annual savings through Value Engineering. BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES High attention to detail (zero-error mindset). You'll sit at the center of the quote-to-cash process and serve as the subject matter expert for sales-assisted quotes in Salesforce. You'll ensure deal intent is accurately captured in quotes, order forms, and bookings, and help resolve issues before they require systems or information technology support.</p> <p>You'll act as a trusted advisor, using your knowledge of deal structures, approvals, and contract language to guide deals toward compliant, scalable solutions that help close business. You'll work daily with Salesforce and Zuora Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), or similar tools, to review pricing and products, validate order forms, and troubleshoot issues. When needed, you'll complete manual checks using Google Sheets, Excel, or similar spreadsheet tools.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with Sales, Accounts Receivable, Billing, Ecosystem, and Revenue teams to support accurate annual recurring revenue (ARR) reporting, smooth collections, and data integrity across the revenue lifecycle. Deal Desk and Sales as GitLab continues to expand its AI-powered DevSecOps platform.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted advisor and go-to resource on deal quote review process, including validating Salesforce opportunities, quotes, and order forms to ensure accurate deal structures, metrics, and downstream bookings.</li> <li>Review sales-assisted contracts from Salesforce for accuracy and intent, confirming that commercial terms, including price locks and billing terms, are correctly reflected and comply with revenue recognition requirements clear guidance that reduces errors and rework.</li> <li>Participate in regional sales forecast calls, quarterly business reviews, and end-of-quarter standups, providing clear updates on deal status, risks, and required actions.</li> <li>Work hours aligned with the GMT+10 time zone.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience supporting quoting, pricing, opportunity booking, subscription management, and bookings within Deal Desk, billing operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or a similar quote-to-cash function.</li> <li>The ability to provide discounting and pricing guidance, with an understanding of standalone selling price and profitability ranges.</li> <li>Strong CPQ skills and technical knowledge, ideally including experience with Zuora or a similar tool, and the ability to understand how calculations and charges are generated across products and pricing models. Experience with consumption-based structures is a plus.</li> <li>Practical Salesforce experience, including creating and reviewing quotes, managing opportunities, and troubleshooting data or process issues to support accurate booking metrics.</li> <li>The ability to interpret commercial contracts and understand how legal and commercial terms, including price locks and term commitments, affect deal structure, pricing, bookings, and approvals.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a focus on accuracy across quotes, order forms, and bookings, including the ability to validate or recreate scenarios using Google Sheets, Excel, or similar tools.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the initiative to identify the root causes of quote-to-cash issues and partner with systems and cross-functional teams to prevent recurring errors.</li> <li>An understanding of revenue recognition concepts in a software-as-a-service environment and experience partnering with Finance, Billing, Accounts Receivable, Ecosystem, and Revenue teams to support compliant, timely bookings and collections.</li> <li>Clear, concise communication skills and the ability to advise and build trust with Sales teams in a highly collaborative, remote environment.</li> <li>Experience with enterprise deal structures and legal terms that may affect contract structure.</li> <li>The ability to prioritize your workload in line with Sales expectations and changing business needs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Our Deal Desk team is responsible for the processes that power GitLab's end-to-end sales bookings, from quoting and deal structuring through contract review, booking, and handoff to billing and collections. ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a Tax Lead to join our global Tax and Treasury team. In this pivotal role, you’ll help Notion navigate a complex global tax environment, create tangible value, strengthen our tax operations, and work collaboratively to develop tax-efficient strategies that enable business expansion and innovation. Operating within a specialised, risk-focused "Pillar," this critical operational team builds deep subject matter expertise to ensure financial integrity across the entire customer lifecycle. The team is responsible for conducting rigorous onboarding and ongoing compliance checks, unravelling complex financial crime typologies, and directly mitigating risk through thorough investigation, reporting, and account closures.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Taking ownership of the most complex FinCrime Business Banking tasks,</strong> including standards.</li> <li><strong>Maintaining a regular schedule on core investigative tasks</strong> to sustain your competency levels, directly support the domain’s Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and remain connected to frontline challenges.</li> <li><strong>Actively coaching Investigators</strong> on complex financial crime typologies, best practice, and performance improvement to help drive a culture of excellence.</li> <li><strong>Working closely with our Operations Analysts</strong> to share emerging trends and ensure that operational guidance is continuously updated and effectively embedded across the domain.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>You have deep KYB & AML expertise,</strong> with significant experience conducting end-to-end business due diligence (KYB/EDD) and complex investigations within a regulated financial setting.</li> <li><strong>You are a skilled researcher,</strong> with a proven ability to leverage open-source intelligence and analysis to thoroughly corroborate customer profiles and transactional activity.</li> <li><strong>You know regulations and typologies,</strong> possessing a strong grasp of UK and international financial crime trends affecting business accounts and the UK SAR regime.</li> <li><strong>You thrive in a fast-paced environment,</strong> maintaining high flexibility and adapting positively to shifting priorities, new guidance, and process changes at short notice.</li> <li><strong>You are impact-driven,</strong> with a genuine desire to protect Monzo and its customers by making a tangible difference in the detection and prevention of financial crime.</li> <li><strong>You bring leadership and improvement skills,</strong> ideally with experience mentoring peers, a track record of escalating process improvements, or a relevant qualification (such as ICA or ACAMS).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>⏰ Shifts you’ll be working</strong></h3> <p>You will work <strong>37.5 hours per week</strong>, Monday to Friday, from 9:00am to 5:30pm. title: Senior Service Analyst, Workforce Management (WFM)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. You'll report to the WFM Service Manager and play a vital role in using data-driven insights to perfectly staff our customer operations and service teams.</p> <p>You will be a strong individual contributor, taking ownership of problems and leading on the design and implementation of solutions from start to finish. We are looking for someone with strong data skills to perform in-depth analysis, automate processes, and create independent Management Information (MI) and dashboards to support operations. You will help us comfortably navigate challenging trade-offs to achieve our goals while giving our customers the best experience possible.<br><br></p> <p>🔑 <strong>You'll play a key role in:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Executive Communication & Reporting:</strong> You will compile data-driven reports that provide key insights and actions for senior stakeholders, including weekly reporting, Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs), Ops Monitoring, and Domain Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs).</li> <li><strong>Data Pipeline & Dashboard Creation:</strong> Independently creating fully functional Looker dashboards and developing standalone MI to support the operations teams.</li> <li><strong>In-depth Analysis & Automation:</strong> Performing confident root-cause analysis by filtering, merging, and amending complex data across Looker, Anaplan, Airtable, and Google Sheets. You will write efficient SQL code and facilitate automation wherever possible to improve efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Dynamic Burndown Plans:</strong> Creating dynamic burndown plans to accurately predict return-to-service dates and forecast when service situations will be fully resolved.</li> <li><strong>Incident Management & Rota:</strong> Taking responsibility for managing cross-domain incidents using data-driven and dynamic solutions. You will be on call for incidents as part of a Monday to Friday rota. You may occasionally be asked to work a weekend to support very specific projects, but this is not part of your standard working pattern.</li> <li><strong>Service Deep Dives & Routing:</strong> Conducting deep dives to identify gaps between supply and demand, managing task views and routing, and ensuring the right work goes to the right person at the right time.</li> <li><strong>Global Ops Alignment:</strong> Working closely with our global ops functions to ensure performance expectations are met and assessing the service impact of proposed changes across various domains.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>🤩 <strong>We'd love to hear from you if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have demonstrable experience in service delivery, optimisation, and workforce management within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</li> <li>You are highly capable of managing a project's entire lifecycle with little oversight, taking accountability for driving solutions and leading implementation.</li> <li>You possess an advanced ability to use Looker and Google Sheets for deep data storytelling and presenting clear findings via Google Slides and Documentsx.</li> <li>You have experience handling incidents, creating actionable plans, and thinking of dynamic, data-driven solutions.</li> <li>You are comfortable with critical conversations, communicating effectively to a wide range of stakeholders, and coaching those around you to elevate team performance.</li> <li>You have a great understanding of task views, task types, routing, scheduled activities, and workforce optimisation principles.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p>🙌 <strong>What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£40,400 - £51,050 (12-Month Fixed Term Contract).<br>📍This role can be based remotely anywhere in the UK, or our London or Cardiff office.<br>⏰ You will be on call for incidents as part of a Monday to Friday rota. You may occasionally be asked to work a weekend to support very specific projects, but this is not part of your standard working pattern.<br>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.<br>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.<br>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits.</a></p> <p><br>🌈 <strong>The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Application Questions</li> <li>Call with a Recruiter</li> <li>Task</li> <li>Interview (Role-specific and values combined) and Present Back Task</li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process, but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact <a href="mailto:debbieroscoe@monzo.com">debbieroscoe@monzo.com</a>.<br><br>🤖 We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> here</a>.</p> <p><strong>Closing date for this role is the 28th of August 2026.</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>#LI-REMOTE #LI-DR</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Manager, Procurement
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Manager, Procurement, you’ll serve as an individual contributor supporting GitLab’s Chief Technology Officer, Chief Information Security Officer, and Chief Information Officer organizations. You’ll lead strategic sourcing, vendor management, and contract negotiations for critical technology suppliers, with a strong focus on software, cloud infrastructure, and hyperscaler partnerships. You’ll work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners to shape sourcing strategies, improve procurement processes, identify savings opportunities, and explore how artificial intelligence can support procurement and negotiation. This role is expected to report to the Senior Director of Procurement and requires working hours that align with stakeholders across Eastern through Pacific time zones.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Lead strategic sourcing and contract negotiations for software, cloud, infrastructure, consulting, and other technology suppliers.</li> <li>Develop category and sourcing strategies that support the Chief Technology Officer, Chief Information Security Officer, and Chief Information Officer organizations.</li> <li>Manage relationships and lead performance management programs for critical suppliers, including hyperscaler and cloud partners, partnering with business stakeholders to conduct regular business reviews.</li> <li>Conduct detailed spend analysis and market intelligence research within assigned categories, monitoring market trends and supply chain risks.</li> <li>Develop category-specific KPIs and performance metrics, and present category performance reports to senior leadership.</li> <li>Collaborate with stakeholders and Finance Business Partners to forecast demand and manage spend against category budgets.</li> <li>Partner with executives and other stakeholders to understand business needs, evaluate options, and guide procurement decisions.</li> <li>Collaborate with Legal, Finance, Security, Information Technology, and other teams throughout the procurement lifecycle.</li> <li>Identify savings opportunities while balancing cost, risk, service quality, and business needs.</li> <li>Improve procurement and procure-to-pay processes to make them clearer and more efficient, with a focus on reducing cycle times</li> <li>Explore practical ways to use artificial intelligence in procurement processes, analysis, and negotiation preparation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in strategic sourcing, vendor management, and complex contract negotiation.</li> <li>Experience procuring software as a service, cloud infrastructure, or other technical products and services.</li> <li>Working knowledge of cloud hosting, infrastructure services, and the commercial terms used in technology contracts.</li> <li>Understanding of procure-to-pay processes, systems, and procurement operations. Experience with Zip or similar procure-to-pay system is preferred</li> <li>Ability to build trusted partnerships with executives and cross-functional stakeholders.</li> <li>Clear communication skills and the judgment to explain complex commercial topics to different audiences.</li> <li>A collaborative, self-directed approach, with the willingness to step forward, lead discussions, and support teammates.</li> <li>Experience in a software or technology business is preferred, and we welcome relevant experience from other industries.</li> <li>5-7 years of procurement experience, including at least 3 years in category management.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field.</li> <li>Strong financial acumen and analytical capabilities.</li> <li>Advanced project management skills.</li> <li>A proven track record of delivering measurable cost savings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Procurement team helps GitLab team members select and manage the suppliers needed to run the business. Each team member supports different parts of GitLab while following shared processes and goals. The team works closely together to balance workloads, provide coverage, improve how procurement operates, and support high-impact supplier decisions. title: Staff Engineer, People Technology
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Lead People Systems Engineer, you'll drive how GitLab's People systems evolve through an AI-first transformation mindset, putting AI to work across everything we build. You won't just support our people systems, you'll build them: owning the code, pipelines, and integrations that keep GitLab's People automation ecosystem running reliably at scale across Workato, Google Cloud, Claude, Workday, and the tools that power our global workforce. This is a strong fit if you think like a software engineer first, write clean and maintainable code, and thrive at the intersection of people systems, AI, innovation, and automation engineering.</p> <p>In this role, you'll be the technical backbone of our People Technology team, designing, building, and maintaining the automations, agents, and integrations that connect Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, and internal tools. You'll be the go-to technical thought partner for the people group on complex engineering decisions, and your work will compound over time: fewer manual processes, stronger system reliability, and a People technology foundation that scales without friction.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Own the design, development, and maintenance of people system automations and integrations across Workato, Google Cloud Platform, Claude, Workday, Greenhouse and GitLab, writing reliable, well-tested code that runs at scale.</li> <li>Build and maintain integrations between Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, and internal tools using Workday Web Services (WWS) and Slack's API and Bot SDK, diagnosing failures proactively and driving uptime and reliability improvements across the automation stack.</li> <li>Write, version, and maintain automation code in Ruby (or comparable scripting languages) stored in GitLab, with clear documentation, code reviews, and disciplined change management practices.</li> <li>Develop and manage Slack apps and bots that deliver intuitive, automated workflows, reducing friction for People teams and employees across a globally distributed workforce.</li> <li>Move past surface-level requests to diagnose root problems, challenge assumptions, and co-design automation solutions that are durable, scalable, and built to last.</li> <li>Serve as subject matter expert on Workato automation architecture, driving standardization, reusability, and scalability across the People technology integration layer.</li> <li>Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices for People system automation, ensuring changes are tested, reviewed, and safely deployed using GitLab.</li> <li>Leverage AI tools, large language models (LLMs), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks, including Claude, to accelerate automation development and identify opportunities to eliminate manual work across the People Group.</li> <li>Provide technical guidance to teammates and stakeholders, proactively communicating context and decision-making, partnering closely with InfoSec, AI Engineering, and IT, and raising the bar for how automations, agents, and integrations are built, documented, and maintained.</li> <li>Exercise independent judgment on methods and evaluation criteria to obtain quality results, leading others by sharing solutions and problem-solving approaches.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and maintaining code in Ruby or a comparable scripting language (Python, PHP, etc.), you're comfortable in a codebase, write code others can read and maintain, and are willing to learn Ruby if you haven't already.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Workato or a comparable enterprise automation/integration platform, with a track record of building reliable, scalable automation workflows in production environments.</li> <li>Strong experience integrating with Workday using Workday Web Services (WWS), with the instinct to build integrations that are durable, observable, and handle edge cases well.</li> <li>Experience building Slack apps and automations using Slack's API and Bot SDK, with an eye for delivering workflows that actually get used.</li> <li>Proficiency with Git and GitLab for version control, code review, and CI/CD workflows, you treat automation code like production software, not scripts on someone's laptop.</li> <li>Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS; experience with Docker and Kubernetes (GKE is a bonus) for running and maintaining automation services.</li> <li>Experience connecting HR systems including Workday, Greenhouse, and internal tools, with strong instincts for where integration points break and how to keep them reliable.</li> <li>Comfort working with AI tools and MCP frameworks to accelerate development, automate repetitive work, and push the boundaries of what people technology can do.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, you can translate technical architecture into clear decisions and stakeholder updates, and you know when to surface a risk versus just fix it.</li> <li>An engineering mindset applied to people systems: you treat reliability, observability, and maintainability as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts.</li> <li>People system fluency, you understand how HR data flows, why it matters, and how to build automations that handle it with care and accuracy.</li> <li>Intellectual curiosity and a bias for action, you don't wait to be told what's brittle; you find it, frame the fix, and drive it forward.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The People Technology team is building the systems foundation that allows GitLab to scale as a global, all-remote company. We don't just keep the lights on, we push the bar on what people technology can do, constantly improving reliability, usability, and intelligence across the platforms that power our People organization. We work across core systems, integrations, automation, and compliance, partnering closely with stakeholders across time zones to move fast, build with purpose, and create an experience where technology enables people to do their best work.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. You'll own critical company-wide planning and forecasting processes, drive revenue and cash flow analysis, support quarterly and annual earnings materials, and maintain the operating and long-term financial models that inform decisions at the executive and Board level. Reporting to the Director of Corporate FP&A, you'll develop financial forecasts and capital structure decisions that accurately reflect business drivers and investor expectations in a fast-moving, all-remote environment, while helping shape how the team uses AI and automation to move faster with better visibility.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Lead revenue forecasting and planning work across core revenue components, including annual recurring revenue, churn, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop financial models, reporting, and analysis that support Corporate FP&A deliverables for finance leadership.</li> <li>Drive process improvements across close and planning workflows, with a focus on automation, AI-enabled analysis, and faster access to source data.</li> <li>Partner closely with finance teams such as accounting and compensation to support shared planning and reporting needs.</li> <li>Prepare clear commentary and insights for leadership reviews, including work that informs CFO, board, and audit committee discussions.</li> <li>Evaluate current workflows and identify opportunities to replace manual file management with more scalable, automated approaches.</li> <li>Use sound business judgment to connect revenue model outputs to broader financial and operational context.</li> <li>Communicate progress, risks, assumptions, and open questions clearly in a fast-moving environment with quick turnaround times.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in corporate financial planning and analysis with ownership of revenue forecasting, planning, or related financial modeling.</li> <li>Knowledge of SaaS revenue concepts, with working understanding of annual recurring revenue, churn, expansion, and how these drivers affect company performance.</li> <li>Ability to build and improve models while keeping accuracy, clarity, and business usefulness at the center.</li> <li>Experience using automation in finance workflows, along with curiosity about applying AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies to analysis and process improvement.</li> <li>Judgment to distinguish between basic task automation and more advanced, scalable approaches that improve how work gets done.</li> <li>Communication skills that support direct, transparent updates, thoughtful questions, and effective collaboration across finance partners.</li> <li>Comfort working in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment that requires resilience, adaptability, and strong follow-through.</li> <li>Openness to applying transferable experience from adjacent backgrounds if you bring strong financial acumen, an automation mindset, and the ability to learn quickly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Corporate FP&A team supports GitLab's finance leadership through planning, forecasting, and analysis that informs company-level decision-making. This team works closely with partners across finance, including accounting and compensation, and its output helps support leadership reviews for the CFO, board, and audit committee. The work is highly collaborative and runs in an asynchronous, globally distributed environment where clear communication and strong ownership matter. Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Execute technology audits covering SOX compliance, cloud infrastructure across Amazon Web Services, and Google Cloud Platform, application controls, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and machine learning systems, and DevSecOps practices.</li> <li>Design and test IT general controls, application controls, and entity-level controls with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Support the IT SOX program from planning through reporting, including risk-based audit planning, process walkthroughs, testing, and coordination with external co-source providers.</li> <li>Maintain clear, high-quality audit documentation, including risk and control matrices, process flows, test procedures, findings, and business impact assessments.</li> <li>Own remediation efforts by partnering with process owners on practical corrective action plans, validating effectiveness before closure, and preparing status updates for leadership.</li> <li>Collaborate with Engineering, IT Operations, Security, and business process owners to assess emerging risks and evaluate new system implementations for control adequacy and SOX relevance.</li> <li>Review controls across financial statement cycles, including record to report, order to cash, hire to retire, and procure to pay, as well as third-party System and Organization Controls 1 and 2 reports.</li> <li>Use data analytics, automation, and generative artificial intelligence tools to improve audit efficiency, coverage, and quality.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience executing technology audits and risk management work in complex technology environments, including audit planning, testing, reporting, and remediation.</li> <li>Experience supporting IT SOX programs and designing and testing IT general controls and application controls.</li> <li>Knowledge of IT control frameworks such as COBIT, the National Institute of Standards and Technology framework, Information Technology Infrastructure Library, ISO 27001, and the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission Internal Control Framework.</li> <li>Knowledge of cloud security principles and cybersecurity fundamentals, including network security, encryption, identity and access management, vulnerability management, and Zero Trust principles.</li> <li>Experience with modern You'll be measured on automation coverage of lifecycle processes, AI deflection rates, and the reliability of the systems you build.</p> <ul> <li>    <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/">The GitLab Team Member Handbook</a></li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>    Design, build, and own end-to-end automation for the employee lifecycle - onboarding, transfers, role changes, and offboarding - so provisioning and deprovisioning happen accurately and with minimal human touch.</li> <li>    Serve as the technical owner of GitLab's ITSM platform, including service catalog design, workflow, request/incident/change processes, integrations, and platform upgrades.</li> <li>    Increase AI deflection rates for all stakeholders of the ITSM system by deploying and tuning virtual agents, AI search, and agentic resolution, and by measuring what actually resolves requests without human intervention.</li> <li>    Identify repetitive, manual workflows across IT and its partner teams and replace them with automation built in our ITSM and Serval.</li> <li>    Build and maintain integrations between the ITSM platform and GitLab's core systems, including Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, JAMF, Fleet, Workday, and GitLab itself.</li> <li>    Manage IT-owned infrastructure as code across our cloud environments, so every change ships through version control, code review, and an automated, auditable path to production.</li> <li>    Apply SRE principles to the services IT owns: meaningful monitoring and alerting, clear reliability targets, capacity and cost awareness, and blameless post-incident review.</li> <li>    Develop the knowledge management and self-service experiences that feed AI deflection: well-structured articles, catalog items, and conversational flows that stay accurate as systems change.</li> <li>    Instrument automation and AI performance with clear metrics and dashboards, deflection rate, time to resolution, automation coverage, and failure rates, and iterate publicly on the results.</li> <li>    Set engineering standards for the IT automation stack, including version control, testing, code review, environment management, and change control, and mentor support engineers across the IT organization.</li> <li>    Partner with Security and Compliance to ensure lifecycle automation and AI workflows meet access, audit, and control requirements, including SOX and SOC 2.</li> <li>    Document architecture, runbooks, and design decisions in the handbook so the systems you build are transparent, maintainable, and operable by the whole team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>    Breadth as a generalist systems engineer. You have owned a wide range of platforms end to end, and you pick up unfamiliar ones fast enough to own them outright.</li> <li>    Solid infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or similar), with change managed through version control, code review, and automated deployment rather than manual, one-off work.</li> <li>    A working command of SRE principles, including observability, monitoring and alerting, reliability targets, and blameless post-incident review, applied to the services you own.</li> <li>    Experience running workloads in a major public cloud; working knowledge across all three (AWS, GCP, and Azure) is a plus.</li> <li>    Experience designing or operating virtual desktop infrastructure (Azure Virtual Desktop, Amazon WorkSpaces, Citrix, or similar).</li> <li>    A track record automating employee lifecycle processes across HRIS, identity, and endpoint management systems for a distributed or remote workforce.</li> <li>    Experience with workflow automation and iPaaS tooling (Okta Workflows, Serval, or similar) and with an ITSM platform; experience with a major ITSM platform is a plus.</li> <li>    Familiarity with AI-enabled service capabilities such as virtual agents, AI search, and agentic resolution, and an interest in using them to resolve requests without human intervention.</li> <li>    Strong scripting and development skills (Python, JavaScript, or similar), with fluency in REST APIs, webhooks, and event-driven integration patterns.</li> <li>    Experience defining and reporting on operational metrics, with the judgment to know which automation opportunities are worth the investment and which are not.</li> <li>    Excellent written communication skills suited to an all-remote, async-first company, and the ability to influence stakeholders well outside your reporting line.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>IT Engineering builds the systems and automation that make an all-remote company run. We own the platforms behind identity, endpoints, the employee lifecycle, and IT service management, and we treat them like products: versioned, tested, measured, and iterated in the open. We operate the way GitLab builds software - all-remote, async-first, transparent by default, and biased toward automating anything we would otherwise have to do twice. We invest heavily in AI so Team Members get answers instantly and our engineers can spend their energy on higher-leverage work. title: Senior Product Manager, Secret Detection and Vulnerability Research
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a <strong>Senior Product Manager</strong>, you will own GitLab's Secret Detection offering and the Vulnerability Research function that produces the detection content across security products. Secret Detection is one of the highest-signal, highest-volume security capabilities on the platform. Leaked credentials are the most common initial access vector in real breaches, and as AI agents write, commit, and configure more of the software, the surface area for exposed secrets grows faster than the number of humans watching it.</p> <p>You will own the full loop: detect a secret with high precision, tell the customer whether it is still live, get it revoked, and prevent the next one from ever landing. In parallel, you will own vulnerability research as a product asset rather than a back-office function. The detection rules, advisory data, and malicious package and reference intelligence your team produces are what make GitLab's security scanners worth paying for, and they need to ship on a cadence with measurable quality.</p> <p>This is an outcome-owning role - you will carry adoption, retention, and revenue targets for your area and be expected to explain how your roadmap moves them.</p> <p><strong>Some examples of our projects:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Push protection and pre-receive blocking that stops a credential before it reaches a repository, without wrecking developer flow</li> <li>Secret validity checking and automated revocation partnerships with major cloud and SaaS token issuers</li> <li>Detection content pipelines that turn threat research into shipped rules, with precision and recall tracked per rule</li> <li>Intelligence-driven detection of malicious packages, dependencies, and references entering the software supply chain</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Own</strong> the business outcomes for Secret Detection and Vulnerability Research, including adoption, expansion, competitive win rate, and revenue contribution. Bring a point of view on packaging and pricing, not just features.</li> <li><strong>Set</strong> the strategy for the full secret lifecycle: prevention, detection, validation, revocation, and reporting across GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed.</li> <li><strong>Treat</strong> detection content as a product. Define how rules, advisories, and intelligence feeds are sourced, validated, versioned, and measured, and make quality visible to customers.</li> <li><strong>Hold</strong> the line on detection quality. False positives are a product defect and you will own the metrics that prove precision is improving.</li> <li><strong>Work</strong> at the level of the technology. Read the rule syntax, question the entropy heuristics, understand why a scanner missed something, and challenge engineering with informed alternatives.</li> <li><strong>Use</strong> AI to compress the distance between question and answer. Pull your own data, prototype your own flows, synthesize research and competitive input yourself, and bring conclusions rather than requests for someone else to investigate.</li> <li><strong>Build</strong> the case for where AI belongs in the product: triage, rule generation, remediation guidance, and reducing the human review burden per finding.</li> <li><strong>Partner</strong> with engineering, security research, threat intelligence, Field, and GitLab's own Security team, who are one of your most demanding users.</li> <li><strong>Communicate</strong> in writing, asynchronously, with enough precision that a distributed team can act without a meeting.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Domain depth</strong> in application security, vulnerability management, or security research. You have worked on or adjacent to scanners, detection content, threat intelligence, or SDLC security tooling and you know how these products actually get evaluated in a bake-off.</li> <li><strong>Technical credibility</strong> sufficient to earn the respect of a security engineering team. You do not need to have written the scanner, but you should be able to reason about detection logic, data pipelines, CI integration, and the tradeoffs between coverage and noise.</li> <li><strong>Commercial reasoning.</strong> You start from revenue mechanics, buyer motion, and competitive displacement, then work inward to product decisions. Candidates who reason only from feature lists outward are not a fit.</li> <li><strong>Evidence of using AI as a force multiplier</strong> in your own work: research, analysis, data pulls, prototyping, drafting. Consuming a chat assistant occasionally is not the same as restructuring how you work.</li> <li><strong>Judgment under ambiguity.</strong> You bring structured options and a recommendation instead of escalating an open question.</li> <li><strong>Bias for clarity.</strong> You can take a noisy, technical, politically contested problem and produce one page that everyone can align on.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> hands-on background as a developer, security engineer, red teamer, or researcher; experience with credential and token ecosystems; experience commercializing a data or intelligence asset.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>This role sits in GitLab's Security product management organization, which owns application security testing, vulnerability management, supply chain security, secrets management, and AI governance. The Security Section is central to GitLab's Ultimate tier and to the shift toward consumption-based product revenue, so the work is visible to senior leadership and directly tied to company results. You will work asynchronously with engineering, design, and research counterparts across multiple regions, and with the Field teams who take this to market.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. Adani Airports Holding Limited : Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact. Job Purpose: Firefighter is responsible for responding to aircraft and structural fire emergencies, medical emergencies, hazardous material incidents, and other emergencies within the airport premises. This role involves ensuring the safety and security of passengers, crew, and airport personnel by performing firefighting, rescue and emergency medical services. Responsibilities Emergency Response: Respond promptly to aircraft incidents, structural fires, medical emergencies, hazardous materials incidents, and other emergency situations on airport property. Perform firefighting, rescue, and emergency medical services to ensure the safety of individuals and property. Fire Suppression Extinguish fires using various firefighting techniques, including the use of water, foam, dry chemicals, and other firefighting agents. Conduct search and rescue operations in smoke-filled and hazardous environments. Emergency Medical Services Provide first aid and basic life support (BLS) to injured or ill individuals until advanced medical personnel arrive. Assist in the transportation of patients to medical facilities as needed. Operational Readiness Perform daily inspections and maintenance of firefighting vehicles, extinguishers, and personal protective equipment (PPE). Maintain inventory of firefighting supplies and equipment and ensure their readiness for use. Participate in routine emergency response simulations, ICAO-mandated training, and fire drills. Maintain detailed incident reports, training records, and shift logs for regulatory audits. Compliance And Reporting Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations and guidelines related to firefighting and emergency response and ensure all tasks are performed following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Identify potential hazards during patrols and inspections, ensuring immediate corrective action. Prepare and submit accurate incident reports, equipment logs, and other required documentation. title: Field Marketing Manager, Startups
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the open-source backend platform trusted by millions of developers to build web apps, SaaS products, and AI-native applications. Our Partnerships team works across the ecosystem - technology partners, cloud platforms, VCs, accelerators, and startup programs - to make Supabase the default backend for the next generation of companies. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Field Marketing Manager to bring our partner ecosystem to life through enablement, events, and programs to raise awareness of Supabase's value proposition to early stage startups. You'll own the materials, playbooks, and activations that help our partners - VCs, accelerators, incubators and entrepreneurship programs - successfully promote and build with Supabase. That includes organizing Supabase's presence at partner and VC-related events, running office hours, hackathons and VIP dinners, and turning relationships into repeatable, high-impact programs. This role sits on the Partnerships team and reports to the Head of Startups, working closely with teammates across the startup program, GTM, developer relations, and marketing. Because the bulk of our events and partner activity is concentrated in San Francisco and the Bay Area, we strongly prefer candidates based there who can regularly attend and host events in person. It's a great fit for someone who loves the operational craft of enablement and programs and wants to work at the intersection of startups, venture, and developer tools. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and maintain partner enablement materials - decks, one-pagers, playbooks, and activation guides - that help partners across the ecosystem promote and build with Supabase - Manage the operational cadence of partner programs: collaborating on strategy, tracking activations, and keeping program logistics running smoothly across partner types - Organize Supabase's presence at partner and VC-related events — demo days, founder summits, portfolio workshops, partner conferences — including sourcing and preparing speakers for talks and panels - Plan and run Supabase hackathons end-to-end: partner coordination, logistics, sponsorships, judging, prizes, promotion, and post-event follow-through - Coordinate cross-functionally with the Partnerships, Startups, GTM, DevRel, Events and Marketing teams to align enablement and event activity with pipeline goals - Measure and report on program impact — signups, credit redemptions, partner-sourced pipeline, and event outcomes - Identify new enablement and program opportunities across the partner ecosystem and bring proposals with clear ROI to the team WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3–5 years of experience in partner enablement, program management, event marketing, or partner marketing - ideally in developer tools, startups, or venture ecosystems - A track record of running events (hackathons, meetups, conferences, or workshops) from planning through post-event reporting - Strong project management instincts: you keep many moving pieces on track without dropping details - Comfort working and communicating with external stakeholders - technology partners, VCs, accelerators, community leaders - and representing the company professionally - Clear written and verbal communication; you can produce polished enablement materials and brief a speaker with equal ease - A bias toward measurement: you instinctively ask "did this move the needle?" and build metrics-based reporting to answer it - Comfortable in a fast-moving, remote-first environment with a high degree of autonomy - Based in (or willing to relocate to) the San Francisco Bay Area, with availability for regular in-person events, including occasional evenings and weekends NICE TO HAVE - Familiarity with the developer tools landscape, AI infrastructure, and/or hands-on experience with databases like Supabase, Postgres, or similar products - Experience working with startup accelerators (e.g., YC, Techstars) or VC platform teams - Background in developer community or DevRel-adjacent work - Experience with CRM and marketing tools (esp. HubSpot) for tracking program performance HOW YOU'LL SUCCEED IN THE ROLE - Build the core “menu” of events and enablement playbook the Partnerships team will use with every partner going forward - Ship repeatable events and major partner activations with strong attendance and measurable signups - Establish reporting that ties enablement and event activity to partner-sourced pipeline WHY SUPABASE - Fully remote team with flexible working hours - Work directly with the world's top VCs, accelerators, and fastest-growing startups - High ownership: this is a new role you get to shape - Competitive compensation and equity WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
