You'll guide organizations through their digital transformation journeys, from planning through monitoring, using your technical expertise, understanding of cloud and modern software development practices, and strong customer empathy.</p> <p>Reporting to a regional Solutions Architect Manager and partnering closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, you'll own technical evaluations, including proofs of value and workshops, shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management. You'll focus on driving successful platform adoption, influencing revenue growth through solution selling, and building long-term, trust-based relationships that showcase GitLab's differentiated position in an AI-driven DevSecOps landscape.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead technical discovery, demos, and validation to show how GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform meets customers' technical and business needs across the full lifecycle.</li> <li>Drive the technical evaluation process as the directly responsible individual, including solution design, proof of concept or proof of value ownership, workshop design, and the technical components of tenders, audits, and value stream assessments.</li> <li>Collaborate with Account Executives and regional sales teams across Italy to shape and execute account strategies that support new customer acquisition and expansion.</li> <li>Build and deepen relationships with technical practitioners and business leaders, guiding them through GitLab-driven transformation and enabling them to become GitLab advocates.</li> <li>Advise customers on modern software development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, security, and cloud practices, challenging existing approaches to improve return on investment.</li> <li>Serve as the voice of the customer with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing by sharing feedback, use cases, and competitive insights that inform roadmap and positioning.</li> <li>Maintain and extend your technical expertise in GitLab, DevSecOps, AI, and related cloud technologies, creating reusable examples, best practice guidance, and technical collateral for customers and partners.</li> <li>Invest in your own growth and development through ongoing learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to continuously improve the impact of the Solutions Architect team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience engaging with customers in technical pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.</li> <li>Proficiency with the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with GitLab or comparable source control, continuous integration and continuous deployment, and collaboration platforms, and the ability to map platform capabilities to customer use cases.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.</li> <li>Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.</li> <li>Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.</li> <li>Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Solutions Architect team is part of GitLab's Sales organization and serves as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role focused on opportunities across ANZ and reporting into a regional Solutions Architect Manager. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. title: Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>GitLab is an open-core software company that develops the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/platform/">intelligent orchestration platform</a> for DevSecOps, used by more than 100,000 organizations and 50 million people. Our mission is to unlock every team to ship trusted software at the speed of imagination.</p> <p>Software is increasingly built by machines and directed by people. When agentic coding tools accelerate without context, governance, and lifecycle control, teams get speed with chaos. GitLab enables speed with control: customers deploy agents across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) with the orchestration, context, security, and governance to ship trusted software at scale.</p> <p>The same principles show up in how we work. We build a culture of excellence around Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, and we treat AI as a core productivity multiplier. Every team member is expected to put AI into daily workflows to move faster without losing control. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued.</p> <h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market, you own two equal pillars of go-to-market execution for Product & Technical Marketing (PTM). First, you are the strategic and hands-on architect behind GitLab's high-stakes minor and major launches, redesigning the launch operating model with AI agents at its core so customers discover, adopt, and experience GitLab with precision. </p> <p>Second, you run program management on key initiatives that span Product Management and Product Design through Growth Marketing, Comms and Social, and Field Enablement, wherever those motions depend on PTM. PTM team  is responsible for product and solutions marketing, technical writing and documentation, developer advocacy, and globalization, and acts as the glue between these functions across a variety of go-to-market initiatives.</p> <p>You are AI-first by default. When programs still run on many manual steps, you convert that work into team-wide AI workflows, either by shipping the automations yourself or by partnering with the AI Transformation Owner (ATO) for the marketing organization to drive shared skills, adoption, and governance. You are not a reactive deadline chaser. You drive solutions with stakeholders as dates approach, design decision stages so tradeoffs land early, and redesign stages and workflows when product roadmap, growth priorities, or major launch decisions change. You create clarity in ambiguity: frame the problem, present options and tradeoffs, name owners, and optimize for decision velocity.</p> <p>In your first year, you institutionalize a dual operating system: a scalable launch framework for 15+ minor and major launches per year, and a portfolio program practice that maps dependencies from Product and Design through PTM into Growth, Comms, and Field. You ship production agent workflows that cut manual coordination, establish benchmarks for quality, and make go-to-market program management achieve relevance in the AI era, and become a trusted partner across the organization. </p> <p>Reporting to the VP of Product & Technical Marketing, you operate with significant executive visibility and autonomy. You measure success by what lands for customers and the business: pipeline where it matters, and brand and community impact where business requires it, not by activity volume alone.</p> <h2><strong>Some examples of projects:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Orchestrate minor launches that put new platform releases in front of the community</li> <li>Orchestrate major launches tied to company events that move pipeline</li> <li>Orchestrate weekly signal announcements so we stay present in a fast-moving ecosystem</li> <li>Sequence product decisions into PTM and other go-to-market functions, with clear handoffs</li> <li>Keep field enablement on track when they depend on messaging and sales assets</li> <li>Design decision points early so blockers show up before the deadline</li> <li>Scope launches for pipeline and for post-launch adoption when agentic products are involved</li> <li>Build AI workflows that draft briefs, synthesize status, and cut manual program steps</li> <li>Rebuild stages and calendars when roadmap, growth priorities, or launch plans change</li> <li>Run retrospectives that improve the system, and remove process as often as you add it</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Run a concurrent portfolio of PTM-dependent initiatives with clear owners, dates, and tradeoffs</li> <li>Give leadership the context to decide: risks, options, and a recommendation, not status theater</li> <li>Align go-to-market functions when work streams collide or compete for the same people</li> <li>Codify how programs run so each cycle starts sharper than the last</li> <li>Put quality in the path of the work, then confirm market-facing pieces landed as intended</li> <li>Turn recurring coordination into shared AI workflows the team can run without you in the loop</li> <li>Partner with Marketing's ATO when a workflow needs department-wide adoption or guardrails</li> <li>Escalate early with a clear ask when a call sits above the working team</li> <li>Protect focus with smaller core teams, fewer standing meetings, more working sessions</li> <li>Close the loop on results with the data team, then feed what you learn into the next cycle</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Program management for go-to-market across the high-tech industry, with first-hand experience with complex, multi-stakeholder and cross-functional initiatives.</li> <li>Experience building and scaling how programs run in large, distributed orgs, with clear results </li> <li>Hands-on work with AI agents and automations that real teams used in production</li> <li>A track record of turning manual work into AI workflows and helping others adopt them</li> <li>Comfort standing up launch and program frameworks without adding busywork</li> <li>Strong grasp of how product releases and how they impact go-to-market teams</li> <li>Bias to action for priorities: defining risks and clear options for path forward</li> <li>Habit of measuring success by pipeline, adoption, or consumption, not activity counts</li> <li>Ability to run several high-stakes workstreams at once without dropping quality or trust</li> <li>Clear writing and speaking with executives; gets decisions made across competing priorities</li> <li>Influence without direct authority, including with senior leaders</li> <li>Fluency with project tools with AI automation on top, and the ability to use GitLab</li> <li>Ability to travel if needed and comply with the company's travel policy</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Product & Technical Marketing at GitLab is the engine behind how GitLab positions, launches, documents, and evangelizes its value proposition for enterprises worldwide. We connect GitLab's product capabilities to customers and prospects across technical personas and executive buyers, and we partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Growth Marketing, Comms and Social, Field Enablement, Sales, and the broader go-to-market organization so what we build lands in market with clarity, impact, and relevance. We operate as one marketing organization with clear roles: PTM carries the message; Growth activates demand; Comms amplifies narrative; work moves when handoffs are explicit.</p> <p>You serve as the senior operational and program spine inside Product & Technical Marketing. You translate roadmap and positioning strategy into coordinated launches and PTM-dependent initiatives across the go-to-market chain, while building the playbooks and AI-powered workflows that make excellence repeatable at scale. We are building towards an operational model where agents handle the scaffolding of cross-functional programs, freeing team members to focus on strategy and judgement.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. title: Remote Office Assistant
description: Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment. As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement. Why Join Coalition Technologies? We offer: 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance Subsidized gym memberships Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses Office Assistant Responsibilities As an Office Assistant, your duties will include: Answering phones and emails Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars Required Skills and Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole Excellent verbal and written communication skills High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness Strong attention to detail and organizational skills Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers Preferred Skills The following experience is preferred but not required: Intermediate spreadsheet skills Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations Remote Work Environment Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world. Growth Opportunity This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. You'll engage customers well ahead of renewal, lead pricing and commercial discussions, negotiate complex agreements, and proactively address risk so customers can continue to rely on GitLab's DevSecOps platform without disruption. You'll also play a key role in guiding customers through the transition from seat-based licensing to GitLab's consumption-based Flex pricing model, helping them understand usage patterns, model scenarios, and land on a structure that aligns with how their teams actually work. In this quota-carrying role within the Renewals team, you'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product to forecast outcomes, reduce churn, and uncover expansion opportunities — and you'll leverage AI-powered tooling to analyze account health, surface renewal risk earlier, and move faster on the commercial activities that matter most. In your first year, you'll be focused on building strong relationships with key stakeholders in your accounts, consistently delivering on-time renewals, and contributing to scalable renewal processes that support GitLab's long-term growth.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for an assigned portfolio of customer contracts, from early engagement through signed agreement.</li> <li>Develop and execute account-level renewal strategies that protect recurring revenue and reduce customer churn.</li> <li>Prepare renewal proposals, pricing quotes, and contract documentation in line with customer needs and internal guidelines.</li> <li>Lead commercial and contractual negotiations with customer stakeholders, managing pricing discussions, terms, and timelines.</li> <li>Identify and qualify opportunities to expand footprint through upsell and cross-sell in partnership with Sales and Customer Success.</li> <li>Monitor customer health, usage, and satisfaction signals to surface at-risk renewals early and drive mitigation plans.</li> <li>Maintain accurate renewal pipeline, forecasts, and activity tracking in CRM and related systems to enable clear reporting and planning.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and Product teams to remove obstacles, align on strategy, and ensure timely, smooth renewals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience owning an end-to-end renewal motion for subscription or SaaS contracts, including forecasting, negotiation, and closing.</li> <li>Background in B2B subscription-based businesses with a track record of meeting or exceeding renewal and retention goals.</li> <li>Skill in managing a portfolio of renewal accounts at scale while prioritizing high-impact opportunities and risks.</li> <li>Proficiency working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot, along with strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for analysis and reporting.</li> <li>Ability to build productive relationships with customer stakeholders, navigate complex procurement processes, and lead commercial discussions.</li> <li>Experience partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to structure renewals, address adoption gaps, and manage contract terms.</li> <li>Strength in identifying renewal risks early, using customer health and usage data, and developing practical mitigation plans.</li> <li>Openness to learning GitLab's platform and processes, with transferable skills welcomed from renewals, account management, sales, or customer success roles.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Lead Machine Learning Scientist, Business Banking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £115,000 - £150,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <h1>About our Machine Learning Business Banking team</h1> <p>Our mission in Business Banking is to simplify banking for small businesses; making business banking fairer, simpler and more transparent. Monzo Business Banking is fast-growing, is the UK’s most recommended business account for overall service quality. We recently hit 1 million customers and are used by 1 in 6 UK SMEs.</p> <p>We want to help businesses spend less time on financial admin and more time focused on running and growing their business. We’re building intelligent, data-driven and AI/ML-enabled product experiences that help small businesses feel more in control, make better decisions, and get more value from Monzo.</p> <p>ML is at the core of how we build and scale our products, enabling Monzo to make better decisions, faster, and helping us serve businesses more effectively.</p> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist in Business Banking, you’ll help build and ship models that power the next generation of Business Banking experiences. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science and Analytics Engineering to bring ML-enabled product capability into the heart of how we build for businesses.</p> <p>Whether it’s helping businesses understand their cash flow, reducing manual admin, surfacing the right insight at the right moment, or helping teams build intelligent product experiences responsibly, our work makes business banking smarter, simpler and more useful for SMEs.</p> <p> </p> <h1>What you'll be working on</h1> <p>As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you’ll be a technical leader and hands-on individual contributor, spearheading our ML and GenAI capabilities and shipping key models that powers magical Business Banking experiences.</p> <p>You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Be one of the first ML Scientists in Business Banking, bringing leadership through ambiguity by adding structure and direction to our ML capabilities while staying agile and building momentum.</li> <li>Develop and deploy advanced ML models on our cloud-native data platform to serve hundreds of thousands of business customers.</li> <li>Partner with Product, data science and other stakeholders to identify the highest-impact opportunities, size impact, and define success metrics.</li> <li>Decide when to use ML, GenAI, or simpler approaches and be clear on trade-offs.</li> <li>Design robust evaluation and monitoring so we can ship responsibly and measure impact in production.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of batch and near-real-time models (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, predictive models, time-series forecasting).</li> <li>Collaborate closely with MLOps and Backend Engineering to operationalise models end-to-end and raise the bar on ML lifecycle rigor.</li> <li>Set technical standards, mentor others, and support experimentation and iteration.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h1>You should apply if</h1> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems, preferably in a fast-moving tech company.</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping state-of-the-art ML models to production and delivering business impact.</li> <li>You're impact-driven and excited to own the end-to-end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production.</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset; you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so.</li> <li>You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with <code>scikit-learn</code>. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn Go, which is used in many of our backend microservices.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity.</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that small businesses use to run and manage their financial lives every day.</li> <li>You have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions.</li> <li>You’re excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and AI and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain.</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas.</li> <li>You’re excited by the opportunity to help Business Banking evolve into AI and ML-enabled product capability.</li> <li>You can work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Research and Data colleagues to shape product strategy, clarify trade-offs and build things that customers actually use.</li> <li>You’re thoughtful about responsible ML/AI; especially in financial products where trust, transparency and customer control matter.</li> </ul> <h1>Nice to haves</h1> <ul> <li>Experience working on personalisation, ranking, recommendation, forecasting, classification or decisioning problems for customer-facing applications.</li> <li>Experience working on ML systems for fintech, banking, accounting, payments, lending, invoicing, cash flow, tax, risk or business software.</li> <li>Experience with GenAI, LLMs, agentic workflows, retrieval, evaluation frameworks, or human-in-the-loop product experiences.</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices.</li> <li>Experience designing experiments, A/B tests or other approaches to measure product and customer impact.</li> <li>Experience working in regulated environments or with products where explainability, auditability and customer trust are especially important.</li> </ul> <h1>The interview process</h1> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on <a href="mailto:tech-hiring@monzo.com">tech-hiring@monzo.com</a>. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you</h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams.</p> <p>We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working.</p> <p><strong>How our SRE hiring works</strong></p> <p>Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Recruiter Screen:</strong> A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction.</li> <li><strong>Core Technical: </strong>The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review.</li> <li><strong>Hiring Manager Interview: </strong>A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab.</li> <li><strong>Peer Technical: </strong>Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on.</li> <li><strong>Skip-Level Interview: </strong>A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams.</li> </ul> <p>After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.</p> <p><strong>What level am I?</strong></p> <p>We calibrate your level during the process, but here is roughly what each looks like so you know where you might land.</p> <p><strong>Intermediate</strong></p> <ul> <li>You make meaningful contributions to reliability, automation, and operational efficiency, working independently within a scoped area</li> <li>You diagnose issues on your own, understand system dependencies, and can explain the tradeoffs you made</li> <li>You prioritize well, break work into manageable steps, and use automation to reduce toil</li> <li>You document your work clearly and keep yourself moving without needing check-ins</li> </ul> <p><strong>Senior</strong></p> <ul> <li>You drive reliability improvements across multiple projects or services and prioritize them based on real system needs</li> <li>You lead investigations, anticipate cascading failures, and coordinate incident response</li> <li>You own delivery end to end, unblock others, and improve the patterns your team works by</li> <li>You communicate complex ideas clearly, influence how work gets done, and enable coordination across teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Staff</strong></p> <ul> <li>You shape reliability strategy across teams and services and define patterns that others reuse</li> <li>You introduce prevention strategies, identify systemic weaknesses, and influence incident response practices beyond your immediate area</li> <li>You design execution and automation approaches that work at organizational scale</li> <li>You connect reliability work to platform and business needs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Senior Staff</strong></p> <ul> <li>You set technical direction for reliability across a sub-department, not just a team</li> <li>You drive the hardest, most ambiguous systems problems and establish standards and guardrails that multiple teams adopt</li> <li>You mentor Staff and Senior engineers</li> <li>You align reliability strategy with long-range platform direction and represent Infrastructure's interests across the wider Engineering organization</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Keep user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient</li> <li>Build automation and tooling that reduces toil and replaces manual work with repeatable, infrastructure-as-code-driven workflows</li> <li>Operate and troubleshoot production systems on Kubernetes, including deployments, rollouts, and scaling</li> <li>Write and maintain infrastructure as code, and ship changes safely through CI/CD and GitOps</li> <li>Participate in on-call, triage alerts, follow and improve runbooks, and escalate appropriately</li> <li>Contribute to the observability stack, using metrics, logs, and SLOs to detect symptoms early rather than just outages</li> <li>Take part in incident response and post-incident reviews, turning learnings into changes in automation and process</li> <li>Document runbooks, architecture decisions, and reviews so your findings become repeatable practices</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience keeping production systems reliable, combining an operations mindset with real software engineering practice</li> <li>Experience building net-new infrastructure tooling and automation, not just configuring existing tools. For example, Terraform modules, Kubernetes operators or controllers, or production automation and services written from scratch</li> <li>The ability to read, debug, and reason about code. Most of our teams work in Go; some work in Ruby. title: User Researcher, Growth
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: We’re seeking an experienced User Researcher to shape growth-related product decisions by delivering insights that fuel AI experiences. This role blends traditional growth research, such as adoption, monetization, and pricing and packaging, with fast-evolving AI features like Notion Agent and Chat that permeate experiences like onboarding and Workspace creation. It requires a unique mix of user research expertise, strategic foresight, and technical fluency in AI and AI product development. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Design and execute studies that evaluate how people experience Notion with AI in the loop, including how users discover, trust, and get value from AI, and identify barriers to adoption and willingness to pay. - Run mixed-methods research (qual + quant), including interviews, concept testing, prototype/usability testing, diary studies, surveys, and advanced quantitative pricing studies — leveraging AI tooling to scale your research process and work. - Deliver actionable insights that enable us to deeply understand our customers, identify business opportunities, and drive decision-making — leveraging AI to scale your reporting, sharing, and overall impact. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - AI fluency: You’re curious and hands-on with AI products — and can reason about how AI behavior shapes product experience. - Systems thinking - You can understand complex user journeys and growth engines (including the parts users don't see), and identify where experiences breakdown across the system. - Business mindedness: You connect research to business outcomes and can articulate why an insight matters for strategy, growth, and/or revenue. - Data fluency: You know how to understand and leverage experimentation, and how to use behavioral data to sharpen research questions and interpret results. - Pragmatism: You have experience prioritizing and doing research in fast-moving 0→1 environments, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative. - Communication: You evolve how your share research according to the audiences and like getting creative in how you share your insights (ex: videos, podcasts, workshops, etc.) - Experience: 5+ years doing UX research in industry NICE TO HAVES: - Experience researching AI-enabled products (especially agentic/workflow automation), growth journeys, and B2B products - Expertise conducting research with AI research tools (Outset, Listen Labs, Dovetail, etc.) - Masters or PhD Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Behavioral Economics, Anthropology, Sociology, or similar. - Experience communicating research to executive stakeholders. - You’re familiar with the work of computing heroes like Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, Bret Victor, etc. — and understand why we're big fans. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $196,000 - $230,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: AI Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an AI Engineer at GitLab, you'll help build the foundation for GitLab's transformation into an AI-first company. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise AI, you'll be a hands-on technical leader responsible for delivering internal AI-powered solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.</p> <p>Building fast matters, but it's not enough on its own. This role starts with understanding the real problem: mapping how work moves across teams, tools, and handoffs, identifying the true constraint, and validating whether AI is the right solution before you begin development. From there, you'll take ownership from discovery through deployment, combining strong engineering skills with systems thinking and business understanding.</p> <p>Your initial focus will span Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support, where you will embed AI solutions into key systems and workflows. This role offers the opportunity to shape how GitLab team members work, improve flow across the organization, and help advance our mission in a remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Diagnose business problems before building solutions. Map workflows, identify constraints, and confirm whether AI is the right intervention. Be prepared to say "this doesn't need AI" when that's the honest answer.</li> <li>Own AI initiatives end-to-end, from stakeholder discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and iteration.</li> <li>Design, develop, and ship AI-powered solutions quickly, delivering working prototypes in days, not months, with a focus on practical outcomes and measurable business value.</li> <li>Improve organizational flow by building solutions that reduce bottlenecks, shorten lead times, and increase throughput. Measure success using flow metrics alongside adoption and ROI.</li> <li>Integrate AI capabilities into existing systems and workflows using APIs, orchestration tools, and modern AI platforms, including GitLab Duo Agent Platform, where appropriate. The right tool wins, whether that's custom code, a platform, or a well-crafted prompt.</li> <li>Be Customer Zero: leverage and showcase GitLab's AI offerings wherever possible, feeding real-world usage insights back to R&D.</li> <li>Partner closely with stakeholders across functions to understand the real constraints. Ask the right questions, bridge technical and non-technical perspectives, and align on outcomes before jumping to solutions.</li> <li>Define and track success through business metrics, flow metrics, and feedback loops that make performance visible and actionable.</li> <li>Contribute to technical direction by evaluating tools, documenting patterns, and creating reusable foundations that help the team scale its impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Technologist at Heart - </strong>Genuinely invested in technology, the foundational and the cutting-edge in equal measure. You're as energised by a well-designed API integration as you are by the latest foundation model release. You reach for the simplest solution that solves the problem well, rather than forcing new technology when proven approaches would do. AI is a powerful part of your toolkit, but it sits on top of solid engineering fundamentals, not in place of them.</li> <li><strong>Competent, Confident Coding Skills - </strong>You can build working solutions end-to-end, write clean and maintainable code, and debug effectively. Whether your skills were honed in a traditional engineering role, through building automations, or shipping side projects, what matters is that you can deliver production-quality work independently.</li> <li><strong>AI</strong><strong> & LLM </strong><strong>Technical Depth - </strong>Strong proficiency in at least one modern scripting language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) and a solid understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, and integration patterns. Deep, practical experience with modern AI technologies, specifically: Prompt engineering as a core discipline: designing effective system prompts, managing context windows, structuring multi-turn interactions, evaluating output quality, and iterating systematically on prompt design.</li> <li><strong>Model selection and cost-performance trade-offs: </strong>understanding when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, when RAG is the right architecture versus expanding the context window, and how to make principled decisions about capability versus cost.</li> <li><strong>Agentic architecture patterns: </strong>tool use, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop designs, guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and production-grade reliability patterns.Practical fluency across the LLM ecosystem: hands-on experience with models from Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source alternatives, and the judgment to know which to reach for and when.</li> <li><strong>AI Safety & Risk Awareness - </strong>You think critically about how the solutions you build could be exploited, misused, or produce unintended consequences. You know how to design appropriate guardrails (input validation, output filtering, access controls, prompt injection defences, and data leakage prevention) and you treat these as first-class engineering concerns.</li> <li><strong>Systems Thinking & Diagnostic Rigour - </strong>The ability to look at a complex process and see the constraint. Comfortable mapping how work flows end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks, and tracing problems to root causes before proposing solutions. You instinctively ask "what's actually blocking flow here?" before asking "what model should I use?"</li> <li><strong>Business System Expertise - </strong>Familiarity with the landscape of enterprise business systems, CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation (Marketo), support platforms (Zendesk), integration and orchestration tools (Workato), AI platforms (Relevance AI), and enterprise search and knowledge tools (Glean). You don't need deep experience with all of these, but to understand what they do, how they fit together, and be willing to build with and across them. A strong understanding of enterprise data models and workflows is essential.</li> <li><strong>Broad Functional Understanding - </strong>Ability to have meaningful conversations with stakeholders across diverse domains and quickly understand their unique needs.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Ownership - </strong>Track record of owning complex initiatives from discovery through delivery. Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving to measurable outcomes independently.</li> <li><strong>Product Mindset - </strong>Ability to scope MVPs, prioritise ruthlessly, and deliver iteratively. In addition, consider adoption, user experience, and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Preferred requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with GitLab platform and CI/CD workflows</li> <li>Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical roles</li> <li>Familiarity with value stream mapping, flow metrics, or Theory of Constraints thinking</li> <li>Experience with low-code/no-code orchestration tools (n8n, Make, Workato) alongside custom development</li> <li>Previous startup or high-growth company experience</li> <li>Experience mentoring or leading technical projects with junior engineers</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>You will join the Enterprise Technology & AI team. We're the backbone of the organisation, driving transformation in how GitLab team members make decisions, operate at scale, and deliver results for our customers.</p> <p>We believe the best AI solutions start with understanding the system, not the technology. We value people who think in constraints and flow, who build with conviction, and who never stop learning. We work in an all-remote, asynchronous setting, guided by GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Analytics Engineer
description: At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship. The Data team works across Linear, supporting Product, Engineering, and GTM. We own our data pipelines, warehouse, dashboards, analysis, and integrations with third-party tools. As a small team, we focus on building systems that make data accessible and useful across Linear. We’re looking for someone who wants to help shape how we architect, build, and use data as we grow. Location & work mode Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. What you’ll do - Work across Product and GTM (Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance) to turn ambiguous questions and operational needs into useful metrics, models, analyses, and workflows - Build and maintain dbt models and pipelines that create trusted views of our product, customers, and business - Design clear, maintainable data models and improve the testing, documentation, performance, and reliability of our data stack - Build dashboards and self-service reporting in Metabase and Hex, and dig deeper when the answer requires more than a chart - Operationalize data through reverse ETL and partner with GTM Engineering on the scoring, segmentation, automations, and internal tools that help our teams scale - Balance fast, pragmatic answers with durable solutions, recognizing when a one-off request should become a reusable model or workflow - Find ways to leverage emerging tools, LLMs, and coding agents to accelerate development, analysis, testing, and documentation while maintaining a high bar for correctness What we're looking for - 8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or data engineering, ideally at a fast-moving software company - Exceptional SQL and strong hands-on experience with dbt and a modern cloud data warehouse - Track record of owning data projects end-to-end, from shaping an ambiguous problem to shipping something people rely on - Strong data modeling judgment: you think clearly about grain, reusable components, interfaces, dependencies, and maintainability without relying on a single prescribed methodology - Analytical judgment: you know when to answer quickly, when to investigate deeply, and how to turn complex findings into a clear recommendation - Comfortable moving between technical implementation and business context, from debugging a data model to understanding product adoption or sales efficiency - High ownership mentality: self-directed, pragmatic, and willing to challenge a request or approach when something does not make sense - Strong communication skills and experience partnering directly with both technical and non-technical teams - You will partner closely with product and engineering teams to pilot and scale AI solutions, own the operational transformation plan needed to embed AI into day-to-day field workflows, and establish the governance framework that keeps AI adoption safe, compliant, and aligned with company standards. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from strategy to execution without heavy oversight.</p> <p>This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li><strong>AI Enablement Roadmap:</strong> Own and continuously evolve the roadmap for AI-driven enablement initiatives, prioritizing based on field impact, feasibility, and alignment with broader Enterprise AI team and strategy..</li> <li><strong>AI Field Use Cases:</strong> Identify, scope, and execute on high-value AI use cases for the field (e.g., deal support, prospecting, content generation, guided selling, skills, change management), working with stakeholders to define success criteria and measure impact.</li> <li><strong>AI Field Champions: </strong>build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst.</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Ops Transformation Plan:</strong> Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks.</li> <li><strong>AI Governance:</strong> Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Mid-Senior Experience:</strong> Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end.</li> <li><strong>AI Solutions Experience:</strong> Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. Act as the field's primary advocate for AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted prospecting, call intelligence, forecasting copilots, RFP/proposal generation).</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Fluency:</strong> Proven ability to work closely with product and engineering teams, translating field needs into technical requirements and vice versa.</li> <li><strong>Self-Sufficiency:</strong> Comfortable operating with significant autonomy — able to define scope, structure ambiguous problems, and drive work forward without needing detailed direction.</li> <li><strong>Organization & Execution:</strong> Strong project management instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams (roadmap, use cases, ops transformation, governance) in parallel without dropping details.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Mindset:</strong> A builder's orientation toward new technology — curious about what's possible, willing to experiment, and able to separate genuine opportunity from hype.</li> <li><strong>Enablement/Sales Background:</strong> Familiarity with field or sales enablement motions (onboarding, tool adoption, content, coaching) and how AI can realistically augment them.</li> <li><strong>GitLab Values Alignment:</strong> Ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, leaning heavily on transparency and collaboration as defined in the GitLab Handbook.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Enablement & AI function is part of the CRO organization. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. The enablement organization comprises enablement leads serving the CRO business functions, a centralized content group, AI tech resources, and an operations team.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. You'll build and develop a team of Regional Sales Directors who lead Enterprise and Commercial Account Executives, helping financial services customers improve how they build, secure, and deliver software with GitLab's DevSecOps platform.</p> <p>Reporting to the Vice President of Sales, AMER, you'll set the strategy for the area while staying close to customers, leaders, and day-to-day execution. This is an opportunity to build a high-performing sales organization, strengthen key customer and partner relationships, and work across GitLab to create lasting customer value.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Establish and deliver a strategy to win new customers, expand existing accounts with purpose, and create a shared vision for long-term growth.</li> <li value="2">Drive customer success and predictable year-over-year annual recurring revenue growth for GitLab.</li> <li value="3">Recruit, develop, and retain a diverse and effective sales organization of Regional Sales Directors and Strategic Account Executives.</li> <li value="4">Build and maintain key customer relationships, and develop strategies that expand GitLab's customer base in Financial Services.</li> <li value="5">Provide detailed and accurate sales forecasts, manage the overall sales process, and set clear metrics for sales funnel management.</li> <li value="6">Lead at both the strategic and operational levels, translating priorities into consistent execution.</li> <li value="7">Partner with Marketing, Channel, Alliances, Product, Engineering, and other teams to support customer outcomes and growth.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Progressive second-line leadership experience leading teams in strategic sales.</li> <li value="2">Repeatable success recruiting, hiring, developing, and retaining leaders and individual contributors in a high-performing enterprise sales organization.</li> <li value="3">Deep experience selling into accounts in core Financial Services markets.</li> <li value="4">Consistent overachievement against an annual quota. </li> <li value="5">Progressive experience in software sales, preferably with development tools or open source software.</li> <li value="6">A proven record of working closely with channel partners and cross-functional peers to support growth.</li> <li value="7">High integrity, initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate and present clearly to a range of audiences.</li> <li value="8">The ability to adapt, work independently, collaborate effectively, manage an ambitious workload, and learn and use GitLab.</li> <li value="9">A bachelor's degree and the ability to travel as needed in line with GitLab's travel policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Financial Services Sales team helps customers use GitLab to improve how they build, secure, and deliver software. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. You'll guide organizations through their digital transformation journeys, from planning through monitoring, using your technical expertise, understanding of cloud and modern software development practices, and strong customer empathy. Reporting to a regional Solutions Architect manager and partnering closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams, you'll own technical evaluations (including proof of value initiatives and workshops), shape solution architectures, and serve as the voice of the customer back to Product Management. By applying solution selling and architecture experience from planning to monitoring, you also support and enable the successful adoption of the GitLab platform by our SMB EMEA Customers. You work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing organizations to realize customer value. Key milestones include: <ul> <li>In the first 30 days, successful completion of the Solutions Architect Onboarding plan.</li> <li>Within two months, collaborate closely with your peers to gain comprehensive knowledge of the GitLab platform, DevOps practices, and associated technologies and learn through shadowing our value selling approach.</li> <li>Within three months you start to engage with customers, both onsite and remote, in a technical consultancy and advisor role during the pre-sales process while providing technical assistance and solution guidance.</li> </ul> </li> <li>In partnership with the sales team, you formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue targets through the adoption of GitLab.</li> <li>With comprehensive knowledge of the GitLab platform and associated technologies, you educate SMB customers on the value proposition of GitLab while participating in discussions throughout the organization to ensure successful GitLab deployment.</li> <li>You guide technical evaluations via POC/POV ownership, RFP/audit support, and workshop design.</li> <li>You build relationships with people within customer environments to enable them to be GitLab advocates.</li> <li>Serve as the customer advocate to other GitLab teams, including Product Development, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li>Continuously improve your professional skills with a focus on personal mastery and team learning through activities such as training, reading, and seeking mentorship from others.</li> <li>Maintain specialty competency in one or more technologies related to GitLab's market focus through activities such as training, certification, and creation of working examples for reuse internally and by customers and partners</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">1-2+ years of experience engaging with customers in pre-sales, consulting, or similar roles, guiding them through solution design and evaluation.</li> <li value="1">Experience or an eagerness to understand the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern DevSecOps practices and continuous integration and continuous deployment workflows.</li> <li value="1">Practical knowledge of cloud computing concepts and related technologies, with the ability to discuss deployment, security, and operations options with technical teams.</li> <li value="1">Ability to lead technical evaluations such as proofs of concept or proofs of value, contribute to tenders or audits, and design and run workshops or value stream assessments.</li> <li value="1">Clear technical communication and presentation skills, with the ability to adapt messages for practitioners through to senior business and technical decision makers.</li> <li value="1">Skill in building trusted relationships, listening with empathy, and acting as a customer advocate to internal teams such as Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.</li> <li value="1">Motivation to continuously develop professionally, including learning new technologies, deepening GitLab platform expertise, and applying transferable experience from related fields</li> <li value="1">German OR French language fluency - desirable</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We, the Solutions Architect team, are part of GitLab's Sales organization and serve as the technical counterpart to Account Executives, with this role focused on opportunities across our SMB EMEA Sales Segmentation and reporting into a regional Solutions Architect Manager. Our mission is to help customers realize the full value of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform by advising on architecture, running technical evaluations such as proofs of value, and guiding customers through their digital transformation. We work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing, collaborating asynchronously across regions to share best practices, create reusable technical collateral, and act as the voice of the customer. title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), AI Engineering: Agent Observability
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Backend Engineer on the GitLab Agent Observability team, you'll go beyond using AI tools and help define how we design, build systems that allow AI agents to interact with the full software delivery lifecycle, way beyond pure code creation.  <br>In this role you’ll contribute to the development of complex features and help establish architectural patterns both for how to interact with AI Agents across GitLab and how the resulting AI contributions manifest across GitLab. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/ai/agent-foundations/">Agent Foundations</a> stage and adjacent teams within AI engineering. This is a high-visibility area of the product at the intersection of GitLab's core platform and its AI strategy.<br>              </p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop, ship, and maintain features and improvements for Agent Observability and Interactions across both the GitLab monolith backend and the AI gateway in a secure, well-tested, and performant way.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend, and AI specialists to refine requirements and deliver high-quality, iterative product enhancements.</li> <li>Design, implement, and review GraphQL, REST APIs and related backend logic, ensuring reliability, scalability, and clear contracts with frontend clients.</li> <li>Improve and extend automated testing, including RSpec and other frameworks, to strengthen quality, reliability, and developer feedback loops.</li> <li>Share standards, patterns, and learnings with other engineers, raising the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering across the team.</li> <li>Participate in Tier 2<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/on-call/"> on-call rotations</a> to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and enhance observability and resiliency</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building and maintaining production applications with Ruby on Rails, including work with background jobs, APIs, and data models.</li> <li>Comfortable working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends a plus.</li> <li>Proficiency in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability, and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Strong practical experience working with AI tooling on a daily basis. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features and integrations is a plus.</li> <li>SQL skills and familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and understanding data modeling.</li> <li>Openness to learning, collaborating in an async-first, distributed team, and applying transferable skills from related technologies or domains.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, including writing technical proposals and documentation, and collaborating effectively in a remote, asynchronous, cross-functional environment.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Agent Observability is a new functional team within the Agent Execution group. The team itself will initially consist of three engineers across AMER and EMEA timezones. The whole<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/categories/#agent-execution-group"> Agent Execution group</a> consists of 8+ engineers. Beyond the Agent Observability team, Agent Execution consists of further teams focussed on agent tools and executing agents on GitLab’s runners.
